economy.zh:
## 经济新闻板块

**导语**：今日经济面受多重冲击波叠加——中东战火重燃推高原油价格，中国二季度GDP增速创近四年新低，美国通胀虽降温但核心矛盾未解，而美股在分化中上演“冰火两重天”。以下是关键事件梳理：

- **油价飙升与地缘风险**：美国恢复对伊朗港口的海上封锁并继续空袭，布伦特原油突破90美元。特朗普威胁轰炸桥梁和电厂，霍尔木兹海峡局势持续紧张。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-blockade.html)、[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy0608wy8pro)
- **中国GDP失速**：二季度同比仅增4.3%，低于全年目标区间下限，投资大幅下滑。出口虽强但内需疲弱，叠加油价冲击，市场呼吁更大力度刺激。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/china-gdp-retail-sales-investment-june-.html)、[NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/15/business/china-economy-gdp-growth.html)
- **美国通胀降温但结构隐忧**：6月CPI同比3.5%，较前月回落，短暂的美伊停火曾压低能源价格。但战后油价反弹已迅速传导至汽油零售端。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/inflation-cpi-june-2026-in-one-chart.html)、[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/14/june-cpi-report-inflation-cools-iran-deal)
- **IBM暴跌25%创纪录**：因二季度业绩预警，软件和基础设施业务疲软，客户转向硬件。拖累微软等软件板块，市场对AI商业化节奏产生疑虑。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/ibm-warns-second-quarter-earnings-fell-short-of-expectations.html)、[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jul/14/ibm-shares-profit-drop-value)
- **亚洲科技股强势反弹**：SK海力士领涨11%，受美国半导体股回弹带动。中国锂矿企业利润暴增50倍，受益于能源转型。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/sk-hynix-asia-tech-stocks-rally-.html)、[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/commodities/article/3360563/chinas-top-lithium-firms-project-50-fold-profit-surge-amid-energy-transition-boom)
- **美联储政策预期生变**：沃什承诺“货币政策体制变革”，暗示若当选将强力对抗通胀。贴现率会议记录显示内部分歧。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/warsh-promises-inflation-will-be-a-thing-of-the-past-cites-benefits-of-ai-investment-boom.html)、[Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260714a.htm)
- **欧盟人口老龄化与数字欧元并行**：ECB选定36家支付商参与数字欧元试点，覆盖19国。同时欧盟预计人口至2100年下降11.7%，劳动力市场承压。[ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260714~8cd07d9d45.en.html)、[Insight EU](https://news.google.)

**后续观察**：美伊冲突走向仍是油价和通胀的核心变量；中国GDP数据将倒逼更积极的财政与货币宽松；美股AI主题内部严重分化，需警惕业绩不及预期的传导风险。
economy.en:
A volatile 24 hours across global markets saw oil prices surge amid renewed US-Iran hostilities, while US inflation data offered relief and China reported its slowest quarterly growth since 2022. Technology stocks were split, with a historic 25% collapse in IBM offsetting a rally in Asian semiconductors. Meanwhile, the ECB took a major step toward a digital euro, and China's property market showed tentative signs of stabilization.

- **Oil & Geopolitics**: US strikes on Iran and a reinstated naval blockade of Iranian ports sent [oil prices](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-blockade.html) higher. Trump threatened to bomb Iranian infrastructure unless talks resume, while the brief US-Iran ceasefire in June had temporarily cooled [inflation](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/14/june-cpi-report-inflation-cools-iran-deal).
- **China GDP Shock**: China's Q2 GDP grew just 4.3% year-on-year, missing the 4.5-5% target range and marking the weakest pace since 2022. Weak domestic demand and Iran-war-induced oil costs overshadowed strong exports. See [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/china-gdp-retail-sales-investment-june-.html) and [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/15/business/china-economy-gdp-growth.html).
- **US Inflation & Fed**: June CPI rose 3.5% annually, a deceleration from prior months ([chart](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/inflation-cpi-june-2026-in-one-chart.html)). Fed candidate Warsh [pledged](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/warsh-promises-inflation-will-be-a-thing-of-the-past-cites-benefits-of-ai-investment-boom.html) a 'regime change' to defeat inflation, while Social Security COLA estimates for 2027 fell to ~3.7-3.8% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/social-security-cola-in-2027-cooling-inflation-lowers-estimate.html)).
- **AI Winners & Losers**: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan emerged as [AI winners](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/goldman-sachs-and-jpmorgan-chase-are-emerging-as-ai-winners.html) with record trading revenue. In contrast, IBM [crashed 25%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/ibm-warns-second-quarter-earnings-fell-short-of-expectations.html) after a profit warning blamed on software/infrastructure weakness. Meta faces a [lawsuit](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/meta-lawsuit-layoffs-ai.html) over AI-driven layoffs.
- **Asia Tech Rally**: South Korea's KOSPI [surged 8%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE8wUVVPWE4xS3hMR0ttem5tYUc5SnpZV3JYZEpuMERlOXNqUHM5eWxqU2FWdUVuVWtVenFJUzVPbmtpZ21XTU10eFpSXzNST0hmc2pR) intraday, and SK Hynix [jumped 11%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/sk-hynix-asia-tech-stocks-rally-.html) on a rebound in US semiconductor shares.
- **ECB Digital Euro**: The European Central Bank [selected 36 payment providers](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260714~8cd07d9d45.en.html) to join the digital euro pilot across 19 nations, a key milestone for the project.
- **China Property & Lithium**: First-tier home prices [extended a four-month rebound](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360599/chinas-first-tier-home-prices-extend-four-month-rebound-amid-market-stabilisation). Major lithium producers projected [profit surges of 32-49x](https://www.scmp.com/business/commodities/article/3360563/chinas-top-lithium-firms-project-50-fold-profit-surge-amid-energy-transition-boom) on energy transition demand.

**Watch next**: Traders will closely monitor the trajectory of US-Iran hostilities, any stimulus announcement from Beijing following the GDP miss, and upcoming US tech earnings as AI investment cycles shift.

society.zh:
**社会新闻·今日焦点**

过去24小时，全球社会议题呈现多线交织：美伊在霍尔木兹海峡的博弈急剧升级，美国启动对伊朗港口封锁，而伊朗则威胁反制，油价与地缘风险同步攀升；与此同时，西班牙野火致13人遇难，其中7名英国人，极端气候与旅行安全引发关注；中国方面，国台办批驳“新两国论”，人工智能拟人化服务新规正式施行，民生领域“影子账号”骗捐现象被新华社点名；知乎社区则围绕AI客服“消失”与酒店24小时退房制展开激烈辩论，折射出技术替代与消费者权益的深层矛盾。

- **美伊对峙进入新阶段**：美国宣布对伊朗港口实施封锁，伊朗革命卫队声称已对美军在波斯湾基地造成破坏。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crele3r8j19o)与[半岛电视台](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/15/live-trump-says-strikes-on-iran-will-continue-until-i-say?traffic_source=rss)均报道特朗普威胁继续打击伊朗桥梁与发电厂，而[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/14/nx-s1-5893257/us-iran-updates)确认封锁已实际启动，霍尔木兹海峡成冲突“断层线”。
- **西班牙野火酿13死，7名英国人遇难**：[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8l87784ngo)披露当局称12名遇难者为外籍公民，高温与强风加剧火势，欧洲夏季旅游安全警钟再响。
- **特朗普支付E·Jean Carroll 500万美元赔偿**：尽管总统试图推迟，最高法院未予受理，[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dydj1wp93o)指此案标志性意义——在任总统因民事判决支付巨额赔偿。
- **美国国会推进夏令时永久化**：众议院通过特朗普支持法案，[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz9l9venjd8o)称若生效将结束半世纪时钟调整惯例，但参议院前景未明。
- **中国AI新规施行，国台办再批“新两国论”**：[新华社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1PZC1TejEzbGFKTlhrYjYxcDg5QlBzOFdpMHk5V3FvOVBhMmRjWWh2Nlh2SUtmT3g3bXZsZzZYSUpaaDhsWU1QbEtNcmFMWEFPTEhHdjZ6OXFaRS02QmVoZ1hFSnp2VEtmYWxCekV2OUx1QnZyU3lPTmZTYmdqZw)报道人工智能拟人化互动服务正式纳入监管；同日国台办发文明确“新两国论”违背法理历史。
- **委内瑞拉地震救援不力引发社会愤怒**：[卫报](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/14/anger-earthquake-response-venezuela)称政府应对双震（约4500人死亡）饱受批评，民众喊“上帝在惩罚政客”，社会不稳风险加剧。
- **瑞安航空事故：男子险被吸出机舱**：[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cly8yjnw822o)报道其妻描述“若死亦同死”，塞尔维亚籍乘客重伤，航空安全审查或受影响。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突的域内溢出效应——霍尔木兹海峡封锁将直接冲击全球能源贸易，亚洲股市已因通胀数据放缓暂时上涨，但供应链风险尚未完全定价。西班牙火灾与委内瑞拉地震暴露极端气候与治理脆弱性的叠加，而中国AI监管新规与“骗捐”舆情则提示技术治理与社会信任的平衡。

military.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by a dramatic escalation in the US-Iran conflict, with the US striking 170 Iranian targets and Iran retaliating with missile barrages on US bases in Jordan. Meanwhile, the war in Ukraine continues to evolve with innovative unmanned operations, and the South China Sea sees renewed diplomatic friction over the 2016 arbitration ruling. Key developments in missile defense, naval maintenance, and industrial capacity also shape the strategic landscape.

- **US-Iran Conflict Escalates**: The US confirmed strikes on 170 Iranian targets in retaliation for ship attacks, while viral footage shows Iranian missiles hitting US air bases in Jordan, with Patriot interceptors failing ([AOL.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBNRDlIWmlQSnlzc1QtSmxLNWZfY1lmeHFYbTF2N1RUc3M4Y0lrOHM1VFRQSjZJajdYQVoxdXhUN3pQUlZDYUlCRHd4MktzVWFlRDF6Q0xUNEpNUkxUQk1kSVBuRWd1TmdjTHczckdVUXVHQjFfZUJr), [Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPcWl3R3ptWHZIaVZXUDNtanM4RjdCTFdBOTNrWWV4cU5WbWpLWFIxVlMyOUx0Z0kyWFdSakt6czdlWkwwcXFqVjZiUk5hdFI5Ni03cWljaW9XbzlMX1JiWlFVVnhLS19vZ08waHBUb0E0b19QSmhlNTN5YnliQmQ4dmdOWUxWVDJHWWdqQ0Z3UXpMSklZRFdheXR5cU5UUkRlZE1PMGRva2RDczNoWlU5b3Y2QnpGdw)). Trump has threatened to strike Iran's underground 'Pickaxe Mountain' bunker, underscoring targeting challenges ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/trumps-threat-to-strike-irans-pickaxe-mountain-bunkers-front-door-underscores-targeting-challenges)).

- **Ukraine War Developments**: Ukraine reported downing 5 Russian ballistic missiles and sinking a Russian border guard ship involved in the 2018 Kerch Strait attack ([Washington Post](https://news.google.), [Kyiv Independent](https://news.google.)). Ukraine also conducted the first fully unmanned amphibious raid, a historic milestone ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/ukraine-unmanned-amphibious-raid-kinburn-split/)). Nine European allies joined a new anti-ballistic missile coalition centered on Ukraine's Freyja system ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/nine-european-allies-join-ukraine-in-new-anti-ballistic-coalition/)).

- **South China Sea Tensions**: Japan and the US led 14 nations in a joint statement on the 10th anniversary of the 2016 South China Sea arbitration ruling, drawing sharp criticism from China ([共同网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9nTDRmcGozRmZwODZyNW1Rb2dEV0lBcy12NDk3NExkQ2NyVXliSlVYNlRUOF9peTVpbnZUX0ZJTVRmemMxR2V2dnlSdE1sYnpVQVBBOGloZw)). Chinese state media accused the Philippines and Japan of destabilizing the region ([guancha.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE43RmJRRFBZQm5HVmltVnk4R1dONm9uaEtQMERFNkJuQVptci1vZjJ0RHR3ZXRqZzdhX0N2YTdIVXdTQVpXOTNNWkF4TEdoeFY1OFlSWW54TGlNRnV0V3k0c1NTQjJyWDlPTlE)).

- **Missile Defense & Industrial Setbacks**: The Space Development Agency awarded L3Harris and Sierra $1.75B for missile defense satellites under the 'Golden Dome' program ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/sda-awards-l3harris-sierra-1-75b-for-missile-defense-satellites/)). However, a new $500M artillery shell plant failed to produce any 155mm parts, threatening Pentagon production goals ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/land/new-500m-artillery-shell-plant-failed-to-produce-any-155mm-parts)).

- **Middle East Spillover**: Saudi Arabia and the Houthis are edging towards war after Houthi missile attacks on Saudi Arabia following strikes on Sanaa airport ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE1JUUEybW1MMS1kY2M5X1pTSHJhQURuNXpMUVlsN1lOcm94cWN6ZEZxVHdNd3djM0RxcWpIdlpKQTVHUnlYLUVXTlRNdWhMQk8wOF9YVS1zQ1dwUQ), [Economic Times](https://news.google.)). Iran also shifts pressure to the Red Sea gateway after Hormuz ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQUGg5NkVYV29DZzNPWWdfQnBqVkllT3BZYlpEMkZEb3JmODhYT0JYMVQ5SHc4cEZoMUh5bnp0TC1ITl9JZ1d2VmZ4T2dFcGY3TDVsUFJhbVdpa0w1LUdFM0M3WU90VXZFWnY4QkhyeUc3SmtlQkJYb05OUENvQWxwU2ZnTkVCcTZyRjh3UUtrYlhMVWMtTmVSTmlObnd1SEhsUk5uUk8tLUdEZ21faGhRc3J3)).

- **Naval & Industrial News**: USS Gerald R. Ford began its first major post-deployment maintenance period ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/14/carrier-uss-gerald-r-ford-starts-first-major-post-deployment-maintenance-period)), and USS Essex is conducting additive manufacturing trials during RIMPAC 26 ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/14/uss-essex-at-the-center-of-additive-manufacturing-trials-during-rimpac-26)). A MARAD ship suffered a fire in Baltimore ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/14/marad-ship-suffers-fire-in-baltimore)).

**Watch next**: The US-Iran conflict remains highly volatile; further strikes or diplomatic moves are likely. Watch for updates on the NDAA as Senate Democrats blocked it over Iran war concerns ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/senate-democrats-block-ndaa-amid-concerns-on-iran-war-budget-topline/)). In Ukraine, the unmanned raid signals a new phase of naval warfare. South China Sea tensions may spike as anniversary rhetoric continues.

tech.zh:
今日科技头条交织着恐慌、矛盾与突破。Lucid Motors被传破产后股价腰斩、CEO火速辟谣，但市场已被拖入对电动初创公司现金流的深度忧虑。同一时间，马斯克悄然买下1GW燃气轮机公司为Grok供电——自称太阳经济旗手的他如今手握化石燃料资产，数据中心能耗账单随之成为HackerNews热议焦点。另一边，AI硬件战打响：OpenAI计划年内发布屏幕可移动音箱，但GPT-5.6被曝自主删除文件；微软十年积淀的Secure Boot漏洞遭曝光，影响数以亿计设备。以下是今日必读的科技情报：

- **[Lucid否认破产，股价仍暴跌40%](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/lucid-lcid-bankruptcy-report-denied/)**：一份报道称Lucid考虑Chapter 11或私有化，导致股票多次熔断、跌幅超40%。公司坚决否认，称现金足够运营至明年，但二级市场信心已动摇。
- **[马斯克买下燃气轮机公司为Grok供电](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/musk-buys-gas-turbine-company-apr-energy-grok/)**：APR Energy的1GW移动燃气轮机将直接服务于xAI的数据中心——这一自救式的能源策略与马斯克的清洁能源叙事形成尖锐反差，也折射出AI算力的巨大野心。
- **[微软Secure Boot被曝十年漏洞，无人察觉](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/microsoft-secure-boot-has-been-broken-for-most-of-its-existence/)**：老旧的“shim”未撤销，攻击者可轻松绕过Secure Boot。微软本日合计修补了570个安全漏洞（创纪录），但补丁本身也带来更新暂停的讨论。
- **[Google/Epic联合撤回禁令，第三方应用商店下周登录Google Play](https://www.theverge.com/policy/965792/google-epic-withdraw-injunction-third-party-app-stores-coming-google-play)**：Epic与Google终局戏剧性逆转——Google同意在自己的平台内托管竞争对手的商店。这是移动生态彻底松绑的标志性时刻。
- **[OpenAI首款硬件被曝：无屏可移动智能音箱](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/14/openais-first-hardware-device-is-reportedly-a-screenless-speaker-that-can-move/)**：Bloomberg报道该设备配摄像头和多传感器，能“理解”环境、充当ChatGPT的物理化身。同时苹果刚起诉OpenAI窃取商业秘密，双方法律战正酣。
- **[数据中心推高电价230亿美元](https://fortune.com/2026/07/14/data-centers-23-billion-electricity-bills/)**：HackerNews头版热文——AI算力需求导致美国公共电费集体上涨，燃机购买、核聚变、小堆等方案开始进入博弈。
- **[三大出版商联合起诉Google AI版权](https://www.engadget.com/2215206/three-publishers-challenge-google-over-ai-copyright-infringement/)**：Hachette、Cengage、Elsevier等指控Google训练AI使用未经授权的作品，新一轮版权风暴叠加在Meta裁员诉讼和Anthropic广告争议之上。

**后续观察**：AI的能耗与版权问题正从舆情走向实质性诉讼和政策监管，硬件化（OpenAI音箱、Apple Siri公测）试图将AI带入日常场景，但安全漏洞和隐私争议可能延缓落地速度。车企在电动化浪潮中两极分化明显——丰田趁势崛起，Lucids与Nissan却在召回和财务危机间挣扎。
tech.en:
The past 24 hours in tech have been dominated by a dramatic EV market meltdown for Lucid, a controversial fossil-fuel pivot by Elon Musk to power AI, and a flurry of security and policy developments. Lucid's stock cratered 40% on a bankruptcy rumor it vehemently denies, underscoring the fragility of the EV sector. Meanwhile, Musk quietly bought a gas turbine company to feed Grok's data centers, exposing the tension between green ambitions and AI's energy demands. In AI hardware, OpenAI is reportedly building a screenless, self-moving speaker, while its GPT-5.6 Sol model is deleting user files without warning. On the security front, Microsoft's Secure Boot has been broken for a decade via unrevoked shims, and a record 570 flaws were patched in July. The UK is planning a social media curfew for teens, and data centers have added $23B to public electricity bills. Google will be forced to carry third-party app stores next week, and Meta is being sued for using biased AI in layoffs. These stories collectively highlight a tech industry grappling with market volatility, energy limits, security debt, and regulatory pushback.

- **[Lucid (LCID) stock halted, crashes 40% on bankruptcy report it denies](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/lucid-lcid-bankruptcy-report-denied/)** — The EV maker's stock was halted multiple times after a report claimed it was considering Chapter 11 or going private. Lucid called the report “completely false” and pointed to its cash position, but the market remains skeptical.
- **[Elon Musk quietly buys a $1 billion gas turbine company to power Grok](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/musk-buys-gas-turbine-company-apr-energy-grok/)** — The self-styled champion of a solar electric economy now owns APR Energy, a fleet of mobile gas and diesel turbines totaling over 1 GW, to feed xAI's electricity-hungry data centers. This move highlights the real-world energy cost of AI scaling.
- **[OpenAI’s first hardware device is reportedly a screenless speaker that can move](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/14/openais-first-hardware-device-is-reportedly-a-screenless-speaker-that-can-move/)** — The device, described as a “physical manifestation of ChatGPT,” will use cameras and sensors to understand its environment. Separately, **[GPT-5.6 Sol is deleting files on its own](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/14/openais-new-flagship-model-deletes-files-on-its-own-people-keep-warning/)** , a known bug OpenAI disclosed in June.
- **[Microsoft’s Secure Boot has been broken for a decade and no one noticed until now](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/microsoft-secure-boot-has-been-broken-for-most-of-its-existence/)** — Old, unrevoked “shims” allow bypasses of Secure Boot on billions of Windows devices. Combined with a **[record 570 security flaws patched](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/07/microsoft-patches-a-record-570-security-flaws/)** , this is a critical moment for enterprise IT.
- **[The UK Is Planning a Social Media Curfew for 16- and 17-Year-Olds](https://www.wired.com/story/the-uk-is-planning-a-social-media-curfew-for-16-and-17-year-olds/)** — Restrictions include a crackdown on “addictive” features and will supplement a total ban for under-16s. A signal of tighter global tech regulation.
- **[Data centers have hiked electricity prices on the public by $23B](https://fortune.com/2026/07/14/data-centers-23-billion-electricity-bills/)** — The cost of AI’s energy appetite is being passed to consumers. Musk’s gas turbine purchase and the BIS report on **[financing the AI boom](https://www.bis.org/publ/bisbull120.pdf)** add context.
- **[Google and Epic give up fighting — third-party Android app stores are coming next week](https://www.theverge.com/policy/965792/google-epic-withdraw-injunction-third-party-app-stores-coming-google-play)** — Google will now be forced to carry rival app stores inside Google Play, a seismic shift in the Android ecosystem.
- **[Former employees sue over Meta's alleged use of biased AI systems during layoffs](https://www.engadget.com/2215258/former-employees-sue-over-meta-s-alleged-use-of-biased-ai-systems-during-layoffs/)** — The suit claims Meta used AI to terminate workers with disabilities and medical problems, raising legal stakes for AI-driven HR decisions.

**Watch next:** Monitor Lucid’s ability to stabilize investor confidence, the rollout of OpenAI’s speaker and the legal fallout from Apple’s trade secret lawsuit, and the real-world deployment of Google’s third-party app stores. The intersection of AI energy consumption and hardware design will be a recurring theme.

sports.zh:
### 体育新闻板块导语

世界杯半决赛战罢，西班牙2-0淘汰法国，将与阿根廷与英格兰的胜者会师决赛。阿根廷与英格兰的半决赛被英媒称为“1966年以来最重要的比赛”，围绕梅西与图赫尔麾下的三狮军团，英阿两队赛前口水仗已打响。与此同时，日本羽毛球公开赛前瞻、CBA球员“出口转内销”争议、虎扑社区关于动漫女主评分与夏联新星的讨论，构成了今日体育新闻的全景。

- **世界杯：西班牙2-0法国**——奥亚萨瓦尔点射、波罗建功，西班牙凭借团队足球压制法国群星，[BBC分析称“团队战胜了个人”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpv3v0gkw9vo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。法国主帅德尚将在三四名决赛告别，[Sky Sports强调这并非他想要的结局](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/czx5x14v5w2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。
- **英阿半决赛前瞻**：英格兰后卫格希称“压力在阿根廷一方”，图赫尔则认为“梅西会激发出最好的英格兰”。[希勒回顾1998年失利](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c6212j5zw3ko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，称“这次可以不同”。阿根廷围绕梅西建队的策略被[Guillem Balague深度剖析](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2j24y9jzyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。
- **转会市场动态**：巴萨不愿放弃阿尔瓦雷斯，准备世界杯后提高报价，[阿森纳和巴黎仍是竞争者](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563502/julian-alvarez-barcelona-refuse-to-give-up-on-argentina-world-cup-star-and-arsenal-and-paris-saint-germain-target)。布莱顿5000万镑签热刺后卫武什科维奇，[虎扑社区热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5KN21fbnloUnNQX2QyRlNkOWNxUDhBdk9qbG00RUt1MGZkZ2tiZktrMnpRU2hMZWQ4S0FyOEQ5VFZDVE9XYmxZckZxV1dTaUhLQ3ZfWEtzN1FqOFQ0Ul9UdDhCbw)。
- **羽毛球**：日本公开赛前瞻，中国全主力出征，石宇奇、刘圣书/谭宁卫冕征程开启；[集团公司职工赛收官](https://news.google.)光州羽毛球馆设计获ArchDaily报道。
- **虎扑社区热门**：动漫女主评分榜争议、世界杯数据盘点、Faker双劫名场面回顾、王者荣耀体验服更新、夏联新星对比（弗拉格vs迪班萨）。
- **篮球**：媒体人再批CBA“出口转内销”；杨瀚森青训历程被讨论；53分杀神（肯巴·沃克？）正式告别NBA转战欧洲；46岁斯科拉成球队老板，家庭篮球世家引姚明对比。

**后续观察**：世界杯决赛对阵将在今日英阿之战后确定，决赛半场时间延长至20-25分钟的消息可能影响战术布置。足球转会市场在世界杯后将迎来高潮，阿尔瓦雷斯、武什科维奇等动向值得追踪。CBA休赛期球员流动与青训话题将持续发酵。
sports.en:
The sports world is fixated on the 2026 FIFA World Cup semi-finals, with Spain booking a final spot after a decisive 2-0 win over France and England preparing for a monumental clash against Argentina. Beyond the pitch, cricket sees England's ODI struggles continue, while basketball news highlights CBA dynamics and NBA departures. The badminton scene gears up for the Japan Open with Chinese shuttlers leading the charge.

- **World Cup Semifinal Showdowns**: Spain convincingly defeated France 2-0 in Dallas, with goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro, ending France's title defense and setting up a final appearance. England faces defending champions Argentina in what is being called their biggest match since 1966, with pundits like Alan Shearer recalling past pains but expressing optimism ([BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c20y0zzdx9go), [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c6212j5zw3ko)).
- **Argentina's Messi-Centric Strategy**: Guillem Balague examines how Argentina's squad is built around Lionel Messi, as they prepare for the semi-final against England. England defender Marc Guehi insists the pressure is on the reigning champions ([BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2j24y9jzyo), [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp8l87vevj2o)).
- **Spain's Team Ethos Triumphs**: In a tournament of superstars, Spain's collective play has been lauded, with analysis highlighting how teamwork outshone individual brilliance against France. This contrasts with the 'World Cup of superstars' narrative dominated by Mbappe and others ([Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563541), [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpv3v0gkw9vo)).
- **Deschamps' Bittersweet Farewell**: Didier Deschamps' storied tenure with France ends with a third-place play-off, a game no one wants, after the semi-final defeat. The half-time break in Sunday's final is expected to last 20-25 minutes, a notable change ([BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/czx5x14v5w2o), [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1wyw9wx19yo)).
- **Cricket: England's ODI Woes Persist**: England's white-ball team, now under Brendon McCullum's reduced role, lost the first ODI to India by six wickets at Edgbaston, highlighting the work needed to rebuild the one-day side ([BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/c1kykzjy4lno), [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/watch/video/13563492/england-vs-india-1st-odi-highlights)).
- **Basketball: NBA Departures and CBA News**: A 53-point scorer leaves the NBA for Europe, while CBA player exports are criticized as 'export-to-import' for higher salaries. Former NBA star Luis Scola becomes a team owner at 46, drawing comparisons to Yao Ming ([网易](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1DMGhuRlNGWXRyRFZYX0pCWUVnREpvbWFUY09iUW1FSk9LcEZBTkN0cGk2ODNVS0xxNzFIQkpOWlc4c200X3A0NlkwZGZwNF9WZ2ZtLW44aDgxYzFzcldKSWdn), [搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNYVVkaFhub1o5dG83clN6SEgxamtFMEJSbk1nOTRQVXVMVEM2QnVuMFh4Um9iQldnTGhid3A2UFFfcjB3VlZJcWN4OGNrR3puNzlBM3Y5M2hwa3NYNk9tbjdjQnQxRnFYbGctZnN1M3pQSHJYUGhPTjRFSGV5TUx2QjdJbVdUdFE1ZlFJRA)).
- **Badminton: Japan Open on Horizon**: China sends a full-strength squad to the 2026 Japan Open, with Shi Yuqi and Liu Shengshu/Tan Ning defending titles. Elsewhere, a company badminton tournament concluded, and a new badminton court design in Gwangju was showcased ([Olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOenlnQ1hRVEszOFRLd2hmcWljX0NUbGdKa3JXZ1I3UWZSUkx6LW12V2hqalpubWd5QUszSWlFZ2RBX1NzX2RQdzBUY21kd0ZlUzgzTTNwVnN0M2dXMjVMX2pqcUVRN3BWb1BjbGVZTzEtalFxWlpqbEtsR1pmN19odTFmejNfZGlBelNXX05PN1pTenFRai1lSzNFTzd5azRsS3ZPMHYya3c5MWZxRjdjSmR1Y2NvZDBkUjhVZGZMdGJ6eHFqS0IwYg)).

**Watch next**: The World Cup semi-final between England and Argentina is the headline event on Wednesday, with analysis of Messi's role and England's tactical response. The Spain-France fallout continues with Deschamps' farewell. In cricket, England must regroup for the second ODI. The Japan Open badminton begins, offering a preview of Olympic contenders.

entertainment.zh:
今天的娱乐头条被派拉蒙的震荡所笼罩：一面是[派拉蒙Primal新厂牌抢下R级喜剧《Boys For Life》](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tyler-falbo-boys-for-life-teyana-taylor-get-lite-release-date-1236982363/)，定档2027年春季；另一面是12个州检察长联手[起诉叫停派拉蒙与华纳兄弟探索的合并案](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/paramount-warner-bros-merger-state-ags-daily-variety-1236810547/)，直指反垄断核心问题——大片是否构成独立市场。韩国方面，NCT 127全员续约SM稳定军心，Jennie与Tame Impala的《Dracula》remix打入Billboard Hot 100前五，创下K-pop女歌手新纪录。中国则迎来《功夫女足》票房破7亿的幕后资本战，以及白宇获亚洲杰出明星奖。微博社区热闹非凡：苗苗秒删、于正删陈都灵合照、邹市明夫妇创业巨亏等话题轮番刷屏。

- 派拉蒙与华纳兄弟的合并案遭遇实质性司法障碍。12个民主党州总检察长提起诉讼，认为合并后将垄断院线大片发行、大片制作和基本有线电视三个市场。[Variety深入分析了反垄断逻辑](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/paramount-warner-bros-rob-bonta-state-ags-sue-blockbusters-1236810931/)，指出该案的关键在于法院是否将“大片”视为独立商品市场。
- 诺兰为《奥德赛》拍摄亲自钻进特洛伊木马，与20位演员共处密闭空间。[Hollywood Reporter报道](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/christopher-nolan-inside-trojan-horse-the-odyssey-premiere-1236648771/)，约翰·雷吉扎莫评价“他不会要求你做他做不到的事”。
- NCT 127七人全员与SM续约，[Soompi证实](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854749wpp/nct-127-renews-contracts-with-sm-entertainment)成员包括Johnny、泰容、Yuta、道英、在玹、廷祐和楷灿。此举为SM稳住核心男团，市场信心初步恢复。
- BLACKPINK Jennie与Tame Impala合作的《Dracula》remix升至Billboard Hot 100第5位，成为继CL之后第二位进入Top 5的K-pop女歌手。[Soompi报道](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854718wpp/blackpinks-jennie-becomes-2nd-female-k-pop-artist-to-enter-top-5-of-billboard-hot-100)称这是她职业生涯新里程碑。
- 中国电影《功夫女足》票房突破7亿，但制片方中国儒意股价出现“冰火两重天”。[网易报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBkbTlVaWpSZnNja29lYWtOS29NUnd5a3JIRWk0SFdZdUV2emVrVjM5QkJVSXNkb2tLRzdURzF1NEwzZzVZa0E1bkVvcWxIRFpNcUpHY2lFNGhZaEhVcUU5N2pn)深入解析了背后的资本战。
- 苗苗秒删微博引爆“跑男”元老离职猜想，[话题阅读量飙升](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxNUmxwR3N6VWZDMFllNUMtUWRBSkVUdE5YQmFLZDhCV3VoZll4SVdDdFFlVXNKVmZkZHMyQXFRSFZCR0Zpa3k4R01ZaTVuLW40QjRiNEZicnBSVkVCbWgxTmJYYk5ScFhHMHlFTGNXRnpiemlZaXRDYVRYWGowYkk4ZmhnbTk2N002NXVuQXhsd1FpWWs1b3BuaUpOREdsQ1JING5ycXIyejB1YjA)。郑恺、李晨等12年元老是否被“卸磨杀驴”成热议焦点。

后续观察：派拉蒙-华纳合并案将进入漫长的司法程序，其结果可能重塑好莱坞院线格局。K-pop方面，NCT续约与Jennie上榜显示市场对头部艺人信心仍在。中国微博社区舆论事件频发，艺人团队需更谨慎应对突发事件。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape over the past 24 hours has been dominated by a major antitrust lawsuit threatening the $111 billion Paramount-Warner Bros. merger, while K-pop continues to break records with BLACKPINK's Jennie hitting the Billboard Hot 100 top 5. Chinese cinema sees a box office milestone with 'Kung Fu Women's Football' crossing 700M yuan, and Weibo is ablaze with celebrity controversies ranging from Zou Shiming's business bankruptcy to Yu Zheng's deleted photos. Below are the critical developments across all desks.

- **Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger Under Legal Siege**: A coalition of 12 Democratic state attorneys general has filed a lawsuit to block the merger, arguing it would create undue concentration in theatrical distribution, tentpole movies, and basic cable. The outcome hinges on whether blockbuster films are considered a separate market. [Read more from Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/paramount-warner-bros-merger-state-ags-daily-variety-1236810547/)
- **Paramount Primal Launches with R-Rated Comedy**: The new label has acquired 'Boys For Life' after a bidding war, setting an April 2027 release. Meanwhile, Teyana Taylor's dance film 'Get Lite' has been pushed to late summer 2027. [Details on Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tyler-falbo-boys-for-life-teyana-taylor-get-lite-release-date-1236982363/)
- **K-Pop Achievements and Setbacks**: NCT 127 renewed contracts with SM Entertainment, ensuring the group's future. Jennie's 'Dracula' remix with Tame Impala reached No. 5 on the Billboard Hot 100, making her the second female K-pop artist to do so. However, ENHYPEN's Sunoo will miss a Mexico concert due to health issues. In China, Zou Shiming and his wife lost 200M yuan in failed businesses, and director Yu Zheng sparked speculation by deleting a photo with actress Chen Duling and later commenting on contract expirations. 美股.zh:
美股周三（7/15）涨跌互现：标普500和纳指在通胀数据降温后小幅走高，但IBM暴跌25%拖累道指。科技板块内部分化——SK海力士等亚洲芯片股反弹带动情绪，而Meta因AI裁员被员工起诉。沃什的鹰派表态为美联储政策转向埋下伏笔。

- **油价飙升压制风险偏好**：美伊冲突推高能源成本，美国汽油均价较去年上涨0.7美元/加仑，侵蚀消费者购买力。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz-blockade.html)
- **IBM血崩**：二季度利润预警导致股价单日跌25%，创1987年“黑色星期一”以来最大跌幅。客户转向硬件采购蚕食软件收入，引发对科技公司业绩依赖性的思考。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/ibm-warns-second-quarter-earnings-fell-short-of-expectations.html)
- **金融AI赢家浮现**：高盛和摩根大通受益于AI带动的交易和投行业务，收入创纪录。AI对华尔街的改造速度超出预期。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/goldman-sachs-and-jpmorgan-chase-are-emerging-as-ai-winners.html)
- **通胀降温不持久**：6月CPI同比3.5%低于前值，但主要来源于短暂的美伊停火窗口。随着封锁重启，7月通胀可能反弹。[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/14/june-cpi-report-inflation-cools-iran-deal)

收束判断：美股短期受地缘和通胀反复拉扯，AI主题内部业绩驱动分化加剧，需警惕权重股暴雷引发连锁反应。
美股.en:
US equities edged higher as June CPI deceleration eased rate fears, but the tech sector was roiled by IBM's historic 25% plunge. Oil-sensitive stocks gained on Iran supply risks, while bank giants Goldman and JPM rode AI trading booms to record revenue.

- **Inflation relief**: CPI rose 3.5% year-on-year, down from prior months, offering a reprieve for rate-sensitive sectors ([chart](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/inflation-cpi-june-2026-in-one-chart.html)).
- **IBM crash**: Shares fell 25% after a profit warning citing weak software and infrastructure sales; the CEO noted clients shifted to hardware ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/ibm-warns-second-quarter-earnings-fell-short-of-expectations.html)).
- **AI banking winners**: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan reported record trading revenue, highlighting Wall Street's AI monetization ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/goldman-sachs-and-jpmorgan-chase-are-emerging-as-ai-winners.html)).
- **Meta AI lawsuit**: Current and former employees sued Meta over alleged discrimination in AI-conducted layoffs, raising regulatory and labor concerns ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/14/meta-lawsuit-layoffs-ai.html)).
- **Fed discount rate minutes**: The Fed released [minutes](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260714a.htm) from June discount rate meetings, confirming ongoing policy tightening debate.

**Signal**: The market's risk-on mood remains fragile as Middle East escalation and AI sector disruption test investor confidence.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲市场关注点集中于数字欧元推进与人口结构挑战。ECB正式选定36家支付服务商（覆盖欧元区19国）参与数字欧元试点，这是央行数字货币迈向实用化的关键步骤。同时，欧盟预估人口至2100年减少11.7%，老龄化将重塑劳动力市场和护理体系，长期增长动力承压。

- **数字欧元加速**：ECB从多家申请者中精选36家，包括银行、金融科技和支付处理商，计划在2027年前完成测试。此举旨在减少对非欧洲支付巨头的依赖。[ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260714~8cd07d9d45.en.html)、[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxONnJIS1MwWGUzVjkxbkF0YS13QzdHakhROUNuR0ctOTZaNTdKZjdoN2o1b3htSFZWN3FzOTE2ZDRzbW11eUhVMExMeHNYYXo0bnBjRG1fNXl0MnBBaGxnTnlzWTh2azVsbWJwR0VUcGxtVlNkZUdwcU9fYm9QOGo4ZTBackYySGUwV3lhbkdaSnFNczFmdDlWRXNvb3pOYkVUVVhPdA)
- **老龄化定时炸弹**：欧盟14.3%的人口预期减少，养老和医疗支出压力加剧。法国24评论称这是“滴答作响的定时炸弹”。[France 24](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxQa3loNGRSSVVRQjMySXBoMWktMURRWXY1cmpmajkwV24yR1JrV2xqRmVMWTd2c3BlS0M2bmFael9KcjhnZ2V5Ym8wQmZ4RUgwOGhCQmxSbzRfdUlWaTFXWHdveUc2d3NMQmRlUG41Sm13NGZFVlk2czYyQkRVYUFPNHpJdWR1NEZmc01xTHd3ZkV2OVpUVEk2dlR6VklkRWxuMTFSYlZsczdQYTJBSGc)
- **中东冲击波**：CaixaBank研究指出，欧洲通胀需重新评估中东油价冲击的影响，尤其对运输和制造业成本。[CaixaBank](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxNSUZLZjJnN2JMVGF2RllpXzVzQm1JcDZhQWpiajJ6aXJ2NHluX3dQWVdGZ3ZYSGxKRFhrSkd2T0VBZEhoWk5zYkxRQlZ6cHdVaUZMRzh0NWxKc3hqenllSGRnZWNPZVJ4Xzg3aWlVWVgwY01YWEtYZ1hSV0pDdkJOOTVSTVRtdlJXTGNhTTllRlVyWFZhakdpaXpCNVMxa1ZRdEtwYmV1VXo0YXBaU2dqbmREQWZUaUtubnJ6Ug)
- **科技巨头欧洲发债**：亚马逊和Alphabet为AI投资在欧洲发行数十亿欧元债券，利用欧洲低利率环境。[Morningstar](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPQUU0el9qRzhiOENiV19oY3hkaEstV1pjem5vT3JGX3loZFYxRERRR1J2cklYOGtGQjJKQ2VHd3BsYXZoV0MyUGc3VmtZZEZGRkxjVGtycEx4cjhWUmlpZnVURUkyUGdRYmluZk40X0c5bmR1ZkxLMEp2QVNNRml2eGVvQ2lObnFwdnNsaE1tR2U1U3BmU0xwX2gwQQ)

收束判断：数字欧元是欧洲金融自主的重要里程碑，但人口老龄化与外部能源冲击将长期制约经济复苏弹性。
欧洲经济.en:
The ECB officially launched the digital euro pilot by selecting 36 payment service providers, marking a significant step toward a central bank digital currency. Meanwhile, demographic headwinds and the Middle East shock are reshaping Europe's economic outlook.

- **Digital euro pilot**: The ECB chose 36 firms to participate in the pilot across 19 EU countries, with the aim of testing infrastructure and user acceptance ([ECB press release](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260714~8cd07d9d45.en.html); also [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxONnJIS1MwWGUzVjkxbkF0YS13QzdHakhROUNuR0ctOTZaNTdKZjdoN2o1b3htSFZWN3FzOTE2ZDRzbW11eUhVMExMeHNYYXo0bnBjRG1fNXl0MnBBaGxnTnlzWTh2azVsbWJwR0VUcGxtVlNkZUdwcU9fYm9QOGo4ZTBackYySGUwV3lhbkdaSnFNczFmdDlWRXNvb3pOYkVUVVhPdA)).
- **Population decline**: EU population could fall 11.7% by 2100, reshaping labor markets and care systems ([INSIGHT EU MONITORING](https://news.google.)).
- **Big Tech borrowing for AI**: Amazon and Alphabet are issuing billions in euro-denominated bonds to fund AI infrastructure in Europe ([Morningstar](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPQUU0el9qRzhiOENiV19oY3hkaEstV1pjem5vT3JGX3loZFYxRERRR1J2cklYOGtGQjJKQ2VHd3BsYXZoV0MyUGc3VmtZZEZGRkxjVGtycEx4cjhWUmlpZnVURUkyUGdRYmluZk40X0c5bmR1ZkxLMEp2QVNNRml2eGVvQ2lObnFwdnNsaE1tR2U1U3BmU0xwX2gwQQ)).
- **Inflation impact**: CaixaBank Research notes European inflation is absorbing the Middle East shock ([link](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxNSUZLZjJnN2JMVGF2RllpXzVzQm1JcDZhQWpiajJ6aXJ2NHluX3dQWVdGZ3ZYSGxKRFhrSkd2T0VBZEhoWk5zYkxRQlZ6cHdVaUZMRzh0NWxKc3hqenllSGRnZWNPZVJ4Xzg3aWlVWVgwY01YWEtYZ1hSV0pDdkJOOTVSTVRtdlJXTGNhTTllRlVyWFZhakdpaXpCNVMxa1ZRdEtwYmV1VXo0YXBaU2dqbmREQWZUaUtubnJ6Ug)).

**Signal**: The digital euro pilot moves Europe closer to a new payments landscape, but demographic and energy shocks remain structural risks.

中国经济.zh:
中国二季度GDP同比增4.3%，低于全年目标（4.5%-5%），投资大幅下滑成为拖累主因。尽管出口和一线城市房价出现企稳信号，但内需疲弱和地缘风险（中东油价）使增长前景蒙阴。A股科创50大跌3.67%，港股则受贸易数据提振小幅上涨。

- **GDP失速引刺激预期**：4.3%的增速为2022年以来最低，远低于市场预期。CNBC和BBC均强调需关注北京是否会加码财政与货币宽松。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/china-gdp-retail-sales-investment-june-.html)、[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd959x4edy8o)
- **一线房价连涨四月**：上海、深圳、广州新房价格环比微涨0.1-0.3%，市场情绪缓慢修复，但整体仍处于低位稳定阶段。[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360599/chinas-first-tier-home-prices-extend-four-month-rebound-amid-market-stabilisation)
- **锂矿暴利50倍**：天齐锂业预计上半年净利同比最高暴增4935%，受益于全球能源转型和储能需求爆发。赣锋锂业同样亮眼。[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/commodities/article/3360563/chinas-top-lithium-firms-project-50-fold-profit-surge-amid-energy-transition-boom)
- **Shein获准赴港IPO**：中国监管部门批准Shein约30亿美元香港IPO，表明政策层面对合规跨境电商企业上市仍持开放态度。[TradingView](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxNWm9IVUt1VDRLbEcwOHdvZWFHaG9Ucy1wSU1fV2t2MFZVMDc4cHJpZ0JkRVdIQWFMVkZab0d0eTZUVWpHU2lSZEwzd010UE5waXVlbmVuQ0lLN2tMQW9QRmYwXzB6SmJ5WHdLdWFpN1VhMGRPbnU3NkI5YTlEZFZ5NjlfSTJkOWZxWTRKa1pGdThyWTU3TFRpMlVOQkNzeHNuYjJ3SE9GLXJ0UDJRNnZIdUVSMDF2R21MMWRQUk9UZTI)
- **A股深度回调**：科创50午盘跌3.67%，PCB、半导体等算力硬件股集体杀跌，市场担忧AI投资热潮降温。同时千亿存储龙头一字跌停。[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBINEVEZ1FFRVRZRFNHNzAtQUlJN3FRUHc0S1Rpb1J4Y1I3NS1WT1MxcF91eTRVVXNRN0h6UThMQ0VCT0kzZlpXUFdqOGxNWTE4NlQwenZZcDNnbDI3Snc)

收束判断：中国经济正经历“外热内冷”格局，出口和新能源撑起半边天，但房地产和内需复苏仍需强力政策托举。
中国经济.en:
China's Q2 GDP growth of 4.3% missed the official target, intensifying calls for stimulus. However, property prices in first-tier cities continued their four-month rebound, and lithium producers flagged massive profit surges on energy transition demand.

- **GDP miss**: Growth slowed to 4.3% year-on-year, below the 4.5-5% target range, driven by investment slump and weak domestic demand ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/china-gdp-retail-sales-investment-june-.html), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd959x4edy8o)).
- **Property stabilization**: New home prices in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen rose 0.1% on average in June, extending a four-month rebound ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360599/chinas-first-tier-home-prices-extend-four-month-rebound-amid-market-stabilisation)).
- **Lithium boom**: Tianqi Lithium and Ganfeng Lithium projected H1 profit surges of 32-49x, driven by global energy independence demand ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/commodities/article/3360563/chinas-top-lithium-firms-project-50-fold-profit-surge-amid-energy-transition-boom)).
- **Shein IPO**: China approved Shein's potential $3 billion Hong Kong IPO, a major test of the city's listing appeal ([TradingView](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxNWm9IVUt1VDRLbEcwOHdvZWFHaG9Ucy1wSU1fV2t2MFZVMDc4cHJpZ0JkRVdIQWFMVkZab0d0eTZUVWpHU2lSZEwzd010UE5waXVlbmVuQ0lLN2tMQW9QRmYwXzB6SmJ5WHdLdWFpN1VhMGRPbnU3NkI5YTlEZFZ5NjlfSTJkOWZxWTRKa1pGdThyWTU3TFRpMlVOQkNzeHNuYjJ3SE9GLXJ0UDJRNnZIdUVSMDF2R21MMWRQUk9UZTI)).
- **Power exports surge**: China's electricity exports to ASEAN jumped 40% in H1 2026 as regional energy security needs rose amid Hormuz tensions ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/economy/global-economy/article/3360517/chinas-power-exports-asean-surge-40-first-half-2026-amid-hormuz-tensions)).

**Signal**: The GDP data heightens the probability of further fiscal and monetary easing, while lithium and property provide pockets of resilience.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
今日同花顺社区情绪两极分化：一面是券商维持买入评级（东吴证券给予中国人寿买入，下调鼎胜新材目标价），一面是千亿存储龙头一字跌停、鲁阳节能披露控股股东破产重整。资金面上，中际旭创单日获融资买入64.73亿元居首，贵金属（钯金）受地缘冲突拉涨。

- **机构研报密集出炉**：东吴证券将鼎胜新材目标价下调至36.6元但仍维持买入，同时给予中国人寿买入评级。显示券商对部分板块仍有信心。[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1UR3NvOUphSGNWa0hTYkt5XzljWHJqN3VJSE5QemhZZjJaY0plOUtZajZ1T2pNZ2p2OEt0N0cyX3EzYU9pQzA4RUhPMlNLdVJXN3pyVUhNU0hSdzR0Wm00dkNB)、[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTE44YUVSSlZCVjh1STVqcFJzUWw0X2wyWjJmY3laOHp4NVVTRU1oM01WVWhRbXFlMlFHNDBBSUYyS0IyRkw1ZGl3X2FFc0NTXzRvT2FlTzdNZ3dUNjZBN3lUQV9NUS1NclE)
- **情绪冰点：千亿存储股跌停**：具体个股未披露，但“一字跌停”暗示利空突发，可能与行业库存或贸易限制有关。[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5maTdfMjZYMnVxTkppZmFkQTBVN0wzZEdaajhiaGR5NmhRYlM3NFFXbXMzQnF4eVBfaHR4Yk5HNk80T2F2Vlg4OW10UXhOYk5YV0t0dzJWWWVlczNjTDBHVTF3)
- **地缘避险资金加仓**：全球最大黄金ETF持仓增加2吨，钯金直线拉涨超3%，反映社区对美伊冲突升级的避险押注。[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBXa2xhOC0tZnJRbE9zcGIxWW1kcHN6cnpsYnlfQ0VUeDJZZGEwTTJmdzZsMEZ5RFgyWmlZb091VE5UUVRmT2NmMnR5bXdfLVRZdDBPYWR0SzlQVEhmcGc)、[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBmU0RjSXpBZ2dpdzRESTJaVE5GNm5wYjJqUFZnemNvb2dqdUJmSE44MmVCLU93UU5DaHBQNEpSYklKbE1LalJtWXlUbU1tRTVZUV81blhJZUpRQllvb2c)
- **融资资金偏好算力**：中际旭创单日获融资买入64.73亿元居首，显示杠杆资金仍看好光模块等AI算力方向。[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9KNU1RTnp5MnE4eDhaRVVxRDRKa3g3dF9iR0JQNWN5NjRqZ0RlcURmZHJtanpkQ3ZYYk52UmdMemM1aG9OUTlja3ByczhTdk13ZE5SQU1vWURPTktwU3c)

收束判断：社区资金在AI主线和避险资产间摇摆，个股暴雷与机构看好并存，短期市场分歧加大。
同花顺社区动态.en:
A-share markets saw a sharp divergence as tech-heavy indices slumped while defensive and commodity plays gained. Brokerage calls and corporate actions dominated retail discussion, with notable profit-taking in storage and semiconductors.

- **Tech rout**: The STAR 50 index (科创板) fell 3.67% as PCB and semiconductor hardware stocks corrected sharply ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBINEVEZ1FFRVRZRFNHNzAtQUlJN3FRUHc0S1Rpb1J4Y1I3NS1WT1MxcF91eTRVVXNRN0h6UThMQ0VCT0kzZlpXUFdqOGxNWTE4NlQwenZZcDNnbDI3Snc)).
- **Individual stock moves**: A 'thousand-billion storage leader' (likely a major memory chipmaker) hit the daily limit down ([一字跌停])([link](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5maTdfMjZYMnVxTkppZmFkQTBVN0wzZEdaajhiaGR5NmhRYlM3NFFXbXMzQnF4eVBfaHR4Yk5HNk80T2F2Vlg4OW10UXhOYk5YV0t0dzJWWWVlczNjTDBHVTF3)).
- **Precious metals surge**: Palladium futures spiked over 3% intraday as US-Iran tensions and rate-hike fears boosted safe-haven demand ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBmU0RjSXpBZ2dpdzRESTJaVE5GNm5wYjJqUFZnemNvb2dqdUJmSE44MmVCLU93UU5DaHBQNEpSYklKbE1LalJtWXlUbU1tRTVZUV81blhJZUpRQllvb2c)).
- **Brokerage calls**: 东吴证券 cut 鼎胜新材 target to 36.6 yuan with a buy rating ([link](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1UR3NvOUphSGNWa0hTYkt5XzljWHJqN3VJSE5QemhZZjJaY0plOUtZajZ1T2pNZ2p2OEt0N0cyX3EzYU9pQzA4RUhPMlNLdVJXN3pyVUhNU0hSdzR0Wm00dkNB)), and gave 中国人寿 a buy rating ([link](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTE44YUVSSlZCVjh1STVqcFJzUWw0X2wyWjJmY3laOHp4NVVTRU1oM01WVWhRbXFlMlFHNDBBSUYyS0IyRkw1ZGl3X2FFc0NTXzRvT2FlTzdNZ3dUNjZBN3lUQV9NUS1NclE)).
- **Gold ETF inflows**: SPDR Gold Trust holdings increased 2.00 tonnes, signaling sustained institutional interest in gold ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBXa2xhOC0tZnJRbE9zcGIxWW1kcHN6cnpsYnlfQ0VUeDJZZGEwTTJmdzZsMEZ5RFgyWmlZb091VE5UUVRmT2NmMnR5bXdfLVRZdDBPYWR0SzlQVEhmcGc)).

**Signal**: Retail investors are rotating out of high-valuation tech into metals and defensive names, echoing global risk-off moves.

欧美.zh:
**欧美·社会动态**

地缘冲突与极端气候主导欧美版面。美伊军事对峙进入“封锁-反制”阶段，特朗普政府在压力下出现政策摇摆，同时西班牙野火、委内瑞拉地震等灾害凸显治理与救助短板。美国国内夏令时永久化法案与特朗普性侵赔偿案并行推进，反映政治极化下的例外事件。
- **[美伊冲突升级：美国启动港口封锁，伊朗声称反击](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/14/nx-s1-5893257/us-iran-updates)**：NPR确认美军实施封锁，伊朗IRGC宣称攻击美军基地，阿尔及利亚等国斡旋停火似乎失效。BBC分析指出霍尔木兹海峡成“断层线”，美国对伊朗战争陷入持久战。
- **[西班牙野火致13死，7名英国人遇难](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8l87784ngo)**：当局确认外籍游客为主，干旱高温叠加强风导致火势失控，欧洲夏季旅游安全风险骤升。
- **[特朗普向E·Jean Carroll支付500万美元赔偿](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dydj1wp93o)**：总统试图通过最高法院延缓支付失败，此案开创在任总统因民事判决支付巨额赔偿的先例。
- **[美国众议院通过夏令时永久化法案](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz9l9venjd8o)**：特朗普支持，若参议院通过将结束半世纪时钟调整，但健康与商业领域的争议仍在。

**收束判断**：美伊博弈正从外交摩擦走向实际封锁，航运与油价波动将触及全球；欧洲旅游业需警惕极端气候频发下的应急机制短板。

日韩.zh:
**日韩·社会扫描**

日韩板块以经济与行业风险为主线：SK海力士创纪录IPO引发全球半导体波动，日本医生过劳问题再敲警钟，七-十一竞标丑闻暴露零售巨头内部合规漏洞。同时，日本海外汇款首次突破1万亿日元，反映在日外籍劳动者规模扩大。
- **[SK海力士美股IPO募资265亿美元，创造外国公司纪录](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9BbTRTbjZIYmdDai12RG5LT1dwaWxfVkpmU2hQMEF2N191MmtWQWlaWjItWHMyR2l4MHp3YWRZRTh2dDhSb29UR29HZHBVaXRHdG5STm1XNA)**：韩国半导体巨头在Nasdaq上市，次日股价飙11%，但韩国杠杆ETF引发全球半导体市场动荡，[朝鲜日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxQQVdFYXVfS05vdm9PUTFIbzU5Y1dGeHNObEotb250QTB5dFBJbi1nMlZaMFM5V0NrM000X1NXZDdITzVyNThNU1lzV0lIaXpSYUFOTVVSdk16QnlwNmk5OHNlaUhxV25nZ0xGdjNxLU5DQmFwRUY4YkZUanFOZENXMmF6VC1sRDBxUHU0aUxR)指出风险传导。
- **[15%日本医生月加班超960小时](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNaDJhQkV6Q1VnaTQ2T0NaQUphQW9acjNxa256OXdDdTktWkNOaG9CbUJFdzhCV1RFNzFiOGxocmhjSWVFZ3AtdnJkWkNrMl90QkNkUWxtaHRBVGI2NGNQTmd6U1RpNTZEaGtCVFB2a2diOG1oYUI5d0VYbXN1LUN1aGwzX0lRWXBsNkMyS3JR)**：厚生劳动省调查显示医学界过劳问题严峻，或引发医疗质量与人才流失危机。
- **[三家公司因七-十一冷藏设备串通投标被突击搜查](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQR3RCNnZjUU5SbzBPSGttZDhJZWpBa0lHeEhDaXZ5TVJGQjlRX0dyN3UxTk4zR0xZTUx3X09rWDhOdlU0T1FoX1R3YjU4TWxPc1dnX3Bsa3ZoR3RkRkVOQ3pETER3WDhnSlFMdHVmYWFXbldHR1E0MnB4anRDRHQzTGxWTHRKRTAxV3cwaDJsdW5USndyS0E)**：日本公平贸易委员会介入，可能影响便利店供应链成本。
- **[土耳其男子在东京警方拘留期间死亡](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxQdmw5WjIwOGZUQW5RanBmZU1Da3Z4TjRUdEJxLUxxNUZvVkZwSUl4SWRSUko1eHZOWHV2S20xNWZ1VjM5Q1BYeFpoV05sQ0ZpU2pHUnkyR3VvLVNYWnl2enJqa1lxRGdad3lBc0djN2xrQ0NyMzJBZUNkbXVONExYTVhrTE5CMXdnUV9iZVdGRno)**：事件引发对日本警察拘留制度的质疑。

**收束判断**：半导体行业狂欢背后隐藏杠杆风险，日本服务业与医疗体系的结构性过劳问题未解，外资企业合规事件频发将增加监管压力。

中国.zh:
**中国·社会脉动**

中国社会聚焦两岸关系、AI治理与基层民生。国台办强硬回应“新两国论”，人工智能拟人化服务管理新规落地，教育领域推进“国优计划”与辟谣网络建设。同时，县域消费与民企发展报告显示经济韧性，但“影子账号”骗捐事件警示网络信任危机。
- **[国台办批“新两国论”：违背法理历史现实](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9lWGVlTlBnbjJEMHJqamtnM1JCdFdlSExyRlVzWUc4SVNDUW9rcWVncU5TWTVuV25rYjFxSS02RkhlRUNPX1k4OEV6dC1hNkk3M1pVaExFWXVldVdRVld6aFNQYmhmTy10YUlyOTNPWG1TUG44eW5GSnVwQUU0Q1U)**：明确界定台海现状，重申一个中国原则。
- **[人工智能拟人化互动服务管理新规施行](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1PZC1TejEzbGFKTlhrYjYxcDg5QlBzOFdpMHk5V3FvOVBhMmRjWWh2Nlh2SUtmT3g3bXZsZzZYSUpaaDhsWU1QbEtNcmFMWEFPTEhHdjZ6OXFaRS02QmVoZ1hFSnp2VEtmYWxCekV2OUx1QnZyU3lPTmZTYmdqZw)**：针对AI聊天、语音助手等拟人化服务提出合规要求，[2026世界人工智能大会](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTFBVaHhvVGM5Wm5wbDUydk55NlFfWk1zbUdXOUYxOEFNQm9zX2NfZDFaMmFPdU9Eelk2OFc0UTNIRE1WN0VpelZuRG9LLVFnZFp5anhSSFVxQkp3cUFhLWJRODdwSy1pNFhiYkstN3RB)同期展示技术趋势。
- **[新华时评：莫让“影子账号”骗捐透支社会信任](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5aYVVPZWVSZU1IRjF3NlpmUzNqUzY4aFRYdUtLb1JVa3ZuanJZV3pkYjdrZm1UdUZ6b3U5Z25tcTcxM1VhY0xETTg1MWpNMTNqcHh4UGtRNXZra3dITmRqcTdHRlB1eDRQczBXNzRzRHh6QVh1NGIxRk0zV1pXZEU)**：点名网络筹款平台存在的黑产账号，呼吁加强身份核验。
- **[中国县域消费新观察](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOU1dUQkpfZzJDUWlnX3RadThvSVlIb1FtM3JGMlFfRkdlTkFnclNBdzNWRVZhaUszNHBfX2t5dE5LUU1NXzMxRDA2WHZXNzA1bDktZWVHc1FmRFlpb2JwRzVTbUk1ZGk1NUdxTWY4ak5SRDBjS3FvdzhNLWNiTWNBQk9naEVVdHB2)**：新华社分析下沉市场消费升级趋势，与[民企报告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE45dzhYWDlDTUoxRDg4QXBPUGw0c0ZLb0JBU3gtVDNVaE5va1ZtVHUwTXZWbFplekE5aERjRFBPX2kwOXpDQ0hTVkgxNGRmQTFhMldRRlNOWkNBYXNCWFl0cGxHX3UzNERsVkdpUmNpNjdqeHc1WVhERGxIbDJPWGc)共同呈现经济基本面。

**收束判断**：AI监管从技术讨论进入实质立法阶段，社会情绪在“台湾问题”与“骗捐”事件中保持高压警惕，县域与民企数据为政策重心提供支撑。

知乎社区动态.zh:
**知乎社区·热议聚焦**

社区热点集中在技术对日常生活的“反噬”与行业革新争议。AI客服大面积替代人工客服引发用户强烈不满，面壁智能获得超50亿融资成为科技圈话题，而酒店24小时退房制落地则激发了消费者与从业者的观点对立。
- **[“消失”的人工客服：一个电话为何逼人到“走投无路”？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1Ray1oS29xU19kWGl4Tnl6dmtHajRWdlUzTGlXNGVIRWZMei1ucmhlME5Lb1F3Z21fRkdWeXRoSlY1NXJVbVlyWWdnWnMtMjVxcjM0dEw4WVZfUzUtNjlyMTJn)** 与 **[AI客服大量上线遭吐槽](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE0yenJGTE9DcTVHOW5yZVY2dFQzWW1kbFUxeFNmRU9KN3g0R1dta1hMbkxkQUlLV0p6c1pNRmdYd3MwbE14LU95WDdoelZKMktPWUkybnhSTkxvMWhsQnFTazJqUlNXc1ZFRTNZQV8xWHdoZw)**：两条高热度帖文互相印证，用户集中抱怨AI客服“死循环”与转人工困难，反映出技术降本与用户体验的尖锐冲突。
- **[面壁智能融资超50亿，估值超200亿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1rRGJtaGNTdEFoTk1tekFxRzhUV2hjUVNQTWc3dFMxa0dnZzMxVWN6MnBMNjBCZHc5Z2UwNFhjUVR6bWlVcFJsM1lCcUV3RDNuM0s3RFNubldHM2o5WThqMDhn)**：中国AI大模型公司再获巨额融资，知乎讨论聚焦估值泡沫与商业化前景。
- **[300万网友热议！酒店24小时退房制落地，消费者点赞从业者反对](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNWHNhOWtDdzZkS2U2MW9meDZKM3N0NXlTZXpUeGZ5dFpwT2w0Si1BYlNhd29CUlBkZy0xdm9mbEU5bDZJaGRYSC1NdXpOUi04eHNSZEowRmM1VnBmcFRKZ3A0MGJhLTVBbWltUENVRHY4dnNMQVdzSkZ1WXpHejV4SS0wX2ZmM2lXdHh6Qg)**：行业革新引发博弈，支持方认为保护消费者权益，反对方指出运营成本上升与卫生管理难题。
- **[蜘蛛侠电影宣发整活，视觉效果震撼](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTE1yQl9kOGdBd19jaHpmdXdYbVdsTXVxTkp5R3NrSnhHX3pCN2x6QWVnZzhmM1V2LWpjRGxfTmxJUU1HcUQxeTJGdjFLcEtZTVloZGZmbi1xRDZOMk5fcHhF)**：营销创意获点赞，但讨论热度低于前三个民生话题。

**收束判断**：社区情绪显示用户对AI“侵入”日常生活的不安加剧，而企业融资与行业规则的变动正在重塑各方的利益格局，公共讨论空间的技术与人性之辩将持续发酵。

国际安全.en:
The US-Iran conflict dominates the international security landscape, with dramatic strikes and counter-strikes. Ukraine continues to build its air defense capabilities with European support, while US defense industrial base issues and satellite procurement highlight strategic vulnerabilities.

- **US Strikes 170 Iran Targets**: The US confirmed hitting 170 Iranian targets in retaliation for ship attacks, while Iran retaliated with missile barrages on US bases in Jordan showing failed Patriot intercepts ([AOL.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBNRDlIWmlQSnlzc1QtSmxLNWZfY1lmeHFYbTF2N1RUc3M4Y0lrOHM1VFRQSjZJajdYQVoxdXhUN3pQUlZDYUlCRHd4MktzVWFlRDF6Q0xUNEpNUkxUQk1kSVBuRWd1TmdjTHczckdVUXVHQjFfZUJr), [Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPcWl3R3ptWHZIaVZXUDNtanM4RjdCTFdBOTNrWWV4cU5WbWpLWFIxVlMyOUx0Z0kyWFdSakt6czdlWkwwcXFqVjZiUk5hdFI5Ni03cWljaW9XbzlMX1JiWlFVVnhLS19vZ08waHBUb0E0b19QSmhlNTN5YnliQmQ4dmdOWUxWVDJHWWdqQ0Z3UXpMSklZRFdheXR5cU5UUkRlZE1PMGRva2RDczNoWlU5b3Y2QnpGdw)). Trump's threat to strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain bunker highlights the difficulty of penetrating deeply buried facilities ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/trumps-threat-to-strike-irans-pickaxe-mountain-bunkers-front-door-underscores-targeting-challenges)).

- **Ukraine Air Defense & European Coalition**: Ukraine downed five Russian ballistic missiles and is bolstering air defenses. Nine European allies joined a new anti-ballistic coalition centered on the Freyja system ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/nine-european-allies-join-ukraine-in-new-anti-ballistic-coalition/)). The SAMP/T system remains Europe's mobile shield ([The Defense Post](https://news.google.)).

- **Defense Industrial & Budget**: A new $500M artillery shell plant failed to produce any 155mm parts, delaying the Army's 100,000-round-per-month goal ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/land/new-500m-artillery-shell-plant-failed-to-produce-any-155mm-parts)). Senate Democrats blocked the NDAA over Iran war and budget concerns ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/senate-democrats-block-ndaa-amid-concerns-on-iran-war-budget-topline/)).

- **Missile Defense Satellites**: SDA awarded $1.75B contracts to L3Harris and Sierra for missile warning/tracking satellites under the 'Golden Dome' program ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/sda-awards-l3harris-sierra-1-75b-for-missile-defense-satellites/)).

- **South Korea Electronic Attack**: South Korea will receive two Global 6500 jammer jets, boosting its electronic warfare capability ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/south-korea-to-get-huge-electronic-attack-boost-with-global-6500-jammer-jets)).

**Signal**: The US-Iran conflict is at a dangerous inflection point; the effectiveness of US strikes and Iranian retaliation will shape the next phase. Watch for Congressional action on the NDAA and further industrial base developments.

中国军情.en:
China's official media and government outlets have launched a coordinated campaign to reaffirm its stance on Taiwan and the South China Sea, coinciding with the 10th anniversary of the 2016 arbitration ruling. The tone is increasingly assertive against Japan, the Philippines, and the US.

- **Taiwan Stance Reaffirmed**: The State Council Taiwan Affairs Office stated that 'the true status quo of the Taiwan Strait is that Taiwan is part of China' ([chinanews.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFB3eU0teDZMV1JVYWpyVV9ZZHU0RkxOT3VJVlBaTklnRzVXRGptZGFOcVNjdGN5TWhSamZ0cHNQbGptMXRubkZsQmFaZEd0VjNjZFJvemJWdENYUFBjYlNLRzdLaXFweWQ3)). This underscores Beijing's rejection of any 'two Chinas' narratives.

- **South China Sea Arbitration Anniversary**: Japan and the US led a joint statement by 14 countries on the 2016 ruling, which China denounces as illegal. Chinese state media labeled Japan as a destabilizing force, with some analysts saying Japan's 'destructiveness may exceed that of the US' ([新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE5QdmEySUsxQlFXcWNZSG15Qmx4di1EVGlhYUdNNFlBVkdtT3l6S0dyTGlhTU9nZ0NPQmZnTkZBS0FUUkVqd3Utcld6QTFTa25IS1dXekpsUllBM3F1UGhaWDR4d184TlNEMWVfcXF0RlRpc0dUYVg5TA)).

- **Philippines Critique**: Chinese media harshly criticized the Philippines for its 'territorial expansion claims' and said the arbitration ruling produces no legal effect ([新华报业网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5oR2drRTdUT0ZlbWNqYnJDVWlQVmlUTUtnNk5qVWJRdENNT21WUXh1b20yaGMxZzE0dTZlLUlWVmFOYm42TkVOQkNfeHhfdmpZSHFZZU40VG5IcmxiUmdvYU55WFluZ3ZFNG1j)). An article from guancha.cn said China's recent actions 'hurt the Philippines' and signal a shift in approach ([guancha.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE43RmJRRFBZQm5HVmltVnk4R1dONm9uaEtQMERFNkJuQVptci1vZjJ0RHR3ZXRqZzdhX0N2YTdIVXdTQVpXOTNNWkF4TEdoeFY1OFlSWW54TGlNRnV0V3k0c1NTQjJyWDlPTlE)).

- **International Law Debate**: A Canadian international law scholar argued that China's non-participation in the arbitration had sound legal basis ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFB6SlN5WHJfRzZfLVd3UTRmM3lIWkhaYUhpUmd5eUYxcl9GWXNRM1VHYnZVTTBpX0VoTXhqaklpeDNaallVTkFQRjJkTHU0eG5VeTlxNnhnXzFTckxqSm1wUV9KZDlxYW5vbENwTXBrb2Z4MWJVdnNF)), while the People's Daily warned the South China Sea is not an 'arena' ([人民日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNcVlEYUx4Z3RpS0lYRy1BeHI0MTRrTWhXTUxaVzRsQU5mVFh2M05KNTdSblZPM2ZRZnRwRXJIWGg0SnB6U00zcDBVTVZ0MThDeUVFZi1uX0ZDTHgzSEtWeVJhYklScXVvRk1PMmRPd29GMVIycWdGUEV5bWtNTmx4Nw)).

**Signal**: Expect continued Chinese rhetoric against the arbitration ruling and further diplomatic and possibly naval assertiveness in the South China Sea as the anniversary generates media focus. Japan's role as a 'troublemaker' may drive bilateral friction.

冲突局势.en:
The Middle East conflict is spreading, with Iran, the Houthis, and Saudi Arabia all engaged in active hostilities. Ukraine emerges as a drone superpower and a key defense partner for Europe. The information war adds complexity to EU missions.

- **Iran-Houthi-Saudi Triangle**: After US-Iran strikes, Houthis launched missiles at Saudi Arabia following airstrikes on Sanaa airport ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE1JUUEybW1MMS1kY2M5X1pTSHJhQURuNXpMUVlsN1lOcm94cWN6ZEZxVHdNd3djM0RxcWpIdlpKQTVHUnlYLUVXTlRNdWhMQk8wOF9YVS1zQ1dwUQ)). The Economic Times reports Saudi and Houthis are edging towards war as the conflict spills over ([Economic Times](https://news.google.)). Iran also threatens the Red Sea gateway as a new pressure point ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQUGg5NkVYV29DZzNPWWdfQnBqVkllT3BZYlpEMkZEb3JmODhYT0JYMVQ5SHc4cEZoMUh5bnp0TC1ITl9JZ1d2VmZ4T2dFcGY3TDVsUFJhbVdpa0w1LUdFM0M3WU90VXZFWnY4QkhyeUc3SmtlQkJYb05OUENvQWxwU2ZnTkVCcTZyRjh3UUtrYlhMVWMtTmVSTmlObnd1SEhsUk5uUk8tLUdEZ21faGhRc3J3)).

- **Ukraine as Drone Superpower**: The Atlantic Council notes Ukraine is now Europe's first line of defense as a drone superpower ([Atlantic Council](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxObk5ZdXJheFZRNkNWdkw5SUNqRG1nOUVHWGZ4eGxCNS0xSXRmb0otNVV2ZHhjaGNmZFF4N003ODlLU1F1NGZaaXFqYnc4dXFkampiNzFxcGh6ZG40QXJKZjloRmhHeUN6YzFlVzNBVThnQS1rS0tqLTlKSVZHMUJYcVBTckJ5MlNkcHgxQ3RXUldYQ3BrQkQwc045bTRCSWFGMFBySlRwZ2dTSDJOdW43UzZrOA)). Global demand for Ukrainian drone and counter-drone expertise is surging ([Soufan Center](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1JV1dNYWFla0FsbVNKSk9HaUlHdVpOTmxMX2lPcklhNHQtQ2RpOUwtd3JFY2dLTVdaRVd5aHhvSnVDd25PQ2JUaWg5c3lJdjZ1QW9qWVBLRUFjWGxsNmVwZ3JB)).

- **EU Support and Information Warfare**: Malta's Fearne called for continued EU support for Ukraine ([Times of Malta](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPaXFDVFRFWFJxZndkSUl6dDEtc0h1ZHRBSmJwSUJ0VEVZWG8yZUFuSFA1UWV4TlJxZHNqeTY5OHRBM1pwcE1meE80WEhwMnFjZXhzZEFnOWY4QmFPa3JCWlFwOWVjV1N0MGZaOFY2RDdQTElmb0JaRTZ0X0VHNndhRlc3SWQ5UXk4clFQMWlmelVSbHVZRVlJ)). Meanwhile, the information space is a minefield for EU CSDP missions, per StopFake ([StopFake](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNM1pvYUcxU0hfc09BZHVObW1RTFFvZVAzUElPUHRZYTUxeDI4QXhLb3I2SU9mSG9nakpLUTZBU3pmTk9lekhvME9NMm9NSElLUmlqQ0VocDFqUnhQZkJ5YldjTFdqV3Zld1BieFg1Q25aZXBzdjZNdEFwY2lDSnRNdVBGMVROWjlqZ2tFMUZjWFIwUW9SMUF2a0JZTXJycUtMTXVaSENLTkloLXRsNWdrS3Radw)).

- **Ankara Summit**: A NATO summit in Ankara covered broader alliance issues, including the Middle East ([Al Arabiya](https://news.google.)).

**Signal**: The Middle East is at risk of a broader conflagration involving Iran, the Houthis, and Saudi Arabia. Ukraine's unmanned warfare capabilities are setting new benchmarks; monitor the impact of the anti-ballistic coalition.

海军与印太.en:
Naval developments include groundbreaking unmanned warfare by Ukraine, maintenance milestones for US carriers, and additive manufacturing trials during RIMPAC 26. A minor fire on a MARAD ship highlights operational risks.

- **Ukraine's Unmanned Amphibious Raid**: Ukraine conducted the first fully unmanned amphibious raid at Kinburn Split, using unmanned sea, land, and air vehicles ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/ukraine-unmanned-amphibious-raid-kinburn-split/)). This historic operation signals a new era in naval warfare, potentially reducing risk to human life while increasing precision.

- **USS Essex and Additive Manufacturing at RIMPAC 26**: USS Essex is testing large-scale 3D printing during RIMPAC 26 in Hawaii, enhancing self-repair capabilities for the Navy and Marine Corps ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/14/uss-essex-at-the-center-of-additive-manufacturing-trials-during-rimpac-26)). This could reduce logistical dependencies in the Indo-Pacific.

- **USS Gerald R. Ford Maintenance**: The carrier began its first major post-deployment maintenance period at Norfolk Naval Shipyard after an 11-month deployment ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/14/carrier-uss-gerald-r-ford-starts-first-major-post-deployment-maintenance-period)). The PIA will be critical for sustaining the Ford-class's operational readiness.

- **MARAD Ship Fire**: A fire broke out on the MARAD ship Charles L. Gilliland in Baltimore, with no injuries reported. The cause is under investigation ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/14/marad-ship-suffers-fire-in-baltimore)). While minor, it underscores the aging state of the US auxiliary fleet.

- **GAO Report on Southern Border Security**: A GAO report detailed DOD's use of multiple strategies to fund operations along the southern border ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/14/gao-report-on-funding-for-southern-border-security)). This highlights the Navy's role in homeland security missions.

**Signal**: The Ukraine unmanned raid will likely inspire other navies to accelerate unmanned systems integration. Watch for RIMPAC 26 outcomes on additive manufacturing and the Ford maintenance timeline.

汽车.zh:
电动车市场惊魂一日：Lucid（LCID）因破产传闻股价闪崩40%，公司虽辟谣，但投资者对烧钱初创的信心已裂谷；马斯克反向操作买下燃气轮机公司APR Energy（1GW容量）为Grok供电，环保人设与现实算力饥渴间的矛盾一览无余。与此同时，比亚迪Denze Z预购5天破千，特斯拉FSD在欧洲累计5000万公里，丰田EV销量暴增225%跻身美前五，而Nissan因安全带缺陷召回近4000辆Leaf。

- [Lucid否认破产，股价仍受重创](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/lucid-lcid-bankruptcy-report-denied/)
- [马斯克买燃气轮机公司为AI供电](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/musk-buys-gas-turbine-company-apr-energy-grok/)
- [比亚迪秦Max EV闪充版首次被拍到](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/byd-qin-max-ev-with-flash-charging-spotted-first-time/)
- [丰田成为美国第五大EV品牌](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/toyota-ranks-top-5-ev-sellers-us/)

一句话：油电转换进入分化期——存粮充足者涨价，缺钱者危险，而算力比马力更吸金。
汽车.en:
The EV sector is in turmoil after Lucid's stock crashed 40% on a bankruptcy rumor it denies, while Elon Musk's purchase of a gas turbine company for Grok AI data centers exposes the energy tension behind the EV narrative. On the positive side, BYD's new Qin Max EV with flash charging was spotted, and Toyota surged into the top 5 US EV sellers with 225% Q2 growth. Prices continued to fall, with Kelley Blue Book data showing June declines.
- **[Lucid (LCID) stock halted, crashes 40% on bankruptcy report it denies](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/lucid-lcid-bankruptcy-report-denied/)** — Lucid denied the report, but the market reaction highlights the precariousness of EV startups.
- **[Elon Musk quietly buys a $1 billion gas turbine company to power Grok](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/musk-buys-gas-turbine-company-apr-energy-grok/)** — A direct contradiction to Musk's solar electric vision; the turbines will feed xAI's data centers.
- **[BYD’s new Qin Max EV with Flash Charging spotted for the first time](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/byd-qin-max-ev-with-flash-charging-spotted-first-time/)** — A “completely different new B-segment fast-charging sedan” from BYD, signaling continued innovation in fast charging.
- **[EV prices just fell again – here’s what US buyers paid in June](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/ev-prices-just-fell-again-heres-what-us-buyers-paid-in-june/)** — Kelley Blue Book data shows June prices dropped, giving buyers more reason to wait.
- **[ChargePoint is bringing ultra-fast EV chargers to 12 busy highway travel plazas](https://electrek.co/2026/07/14/chargepoint-ultra-fast-ev-chargers-12-highway-travel-plazas-onvo/)** — Installation in Pennsylvania and New York will improve road-trip charging infrastructure.
**Signal:** The EV market is bifurcating between cash-strapped startups and scaled producers like BYD and Toyota, with infrastructure and energy costs becoming critical battlegrounds.

科技产品.zh:
微软十年“隐形后门”被挖出——Secure Boot因旧shim未吊销而形同虚设，同日微软发布570个补丁创纪录，并允许Windows 11用户无限暂停更新。Google与Epic搞出教科书级反转：联合撤回禁令、下周在Google Play内托管第三方商店，安卓生态彻底变天。WGA诉讼试图阻止派拉蒙-WBD合并，美国军用无人自爆艇首次参战。硬件圈尴尬一幕：三星990 Pro SSD新版更慢却更贵，Roku可离线使用。

- [微软Secure Boot漏洞影响数亿设备](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/microsoft-secure-boot-has-been-broken-for-most-of-its-existence/)
- [Google Play将开放第三方商店](https://www.theverge.com/policy/965792/google-epic-withdraw-injunction-third-party-app-stores-coming-google-play)
- [美军用无人艇首次实战打击伊朗军港](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/us-military-sent-explosive-drone-boats-into-combat-for-the-first-time/)
- [Windows 11补丁周二允许无限暂停更新](https://www.theverge.com/tech/965643/microsoft-windows-11-july-2026-patch-tuesday-updates)

一句话：软件生态重构与硬件老问题并现，消费者享受开放红利时需警惕暴露的攻击面。
科技产品.en:
Security and antitrust dominated the tech product landscape. Microsoft's Secure Boot was found to have a decade-old vulnerability due to unrevoked shims, while the company also patched a record 570 flaws. Google will be forced to host third-party app stores within Google Play starting next week after the Epic lawsuit withdrawal. Meanwhile, consumer deals on Nintendo Switch 2 and Philips Hue remain attractive.
- **[Microsoft’s Secure Boot has been broken for a decade and no one noticed until now](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/microsoft-secure-boot-has-been-broken-for-most-of-its-existence/)** — Old shims bypass Secure Boot on billions of devices; enterprises should urgently assess exposure.
- **[Google and Epic give up fighting — third-party Android app stores are coming next week](https://www.theverge.com/policy/965792/google-epic-withdraw-injunction-third-party-app-stores-coming-google-play)** — Google confirms it will carry rival stores, a fundamental shift in Android distribution.
- **[Windows 11’s big patch Tuesday allows you to hold off on updates for longer](https://www.theverge.com/tech/965643/microsoft-windows-11-july-2026-patch-tuesday-updates)** — Users can now pause updates up to 35 days, but the Secure Boot vulnerability undercuts confidence.
- **[Nintendo’s Switch 2 bundle that includes a game is $50 off](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/965490/nintendo-switch-2-choose-your-game-bundle-deal-sale)** — Rare discount on the console bundle, now $499.99 with a digital game.
- **[Philips Hue’s budget-friendly Essential starter kit has hit a new low price](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/965476/philips-hue-essential-starter-kit-hue-bridge-deal-sale)** — All-time low for the four-bulb kit with bridge, at $69.99.
**Signal:** The combination of a massive Secure Boot flaw and the opening of Android app stores will reshape both security priorities and the competitive landscape for mobile software distribution.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
社区热榜高度聚焦安全与能源：Tailscale曝出SSH参数处理不当可致root提权（CVSS暂未公开），微软570个补丁创下月度纪录；Fortune文章揭露数据中心对电价推高230亿美元，直接点燃关于AI成本的讨论。温哥华警局网站增设“快速逃离”按钮防止家暴受害者浏览历史被追踪，获得社区174点赞。开发工具方面，Dependabot引入包更新冷却期、HTMX with Go教程热度不减。

- [Tailscale SSH漏洞允许root访问](https://tailscale.com/security-bulletins)
- [数据中心导致电费增230亿美元](https://fortune.com/2026/07/14/data-centers-23-billion-electricity-bills/)
- [温哥华警局网站提供历史擦除按钮](https://vpd.ca/)
- [Dependabot引入包冷却期](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-14-dependabot-version-updates-introduce-default-package-cooldown/)

一句话：从底层安全到能源账单再到用户隐私，开发者的责任边界正在急剧扩大。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community focused on security vulnerabilities, energy costs, and developer tooling. A Tailscale SSH vulnerability could allow root access, Vancouver PD's website features an escape button that wipes browser history, and Microsoft patched a record 570 flaws. Data centers have added $23B to public electricity bills, and a developer solved 20 Erdős problems using parallel Codex accounts.
- **[TS-2026-009: Insecure argument handling in Tailscale SSH permitted root access](https://tailscale.com/security-bulletins)** — Critical vulnerability in Tailscale SSH; users should update immediately. 70 points, 30 comments.
- **[Data centers have hiked electricity prices on the public by $23B](https://fortune.com/2026/07/14/data-centers-23-billion-electricity-bills/)** — A Fortune report quantifies the public cost of AI infrastructure. 112 points, 63 comments.
- **[Vancouver PD website features Quick Escape button that wipes itself from history](https://vpd.ca/)** — A privacy-focused design for domestic violence survivors. 174 points, 64 comments.
- **[Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/07/microsoft-patches-a-record-570-security-flaws/)** — July's Patch Tuesday includes a record number of fixes, reflecting the Secure Boot and other issues. 56 points, 28 comments.
- **[LeMario: Training a JEPA World Model on Super Mario Bros](https://www.benjamin-bai.com/projects/lemario)** — An academic project applying world models to video games. 68 points, 8 comments.
**Signal:** The intersection of security patch volumes, energy transparency, and privacy innovations will drive community discourse and potentially influence corporate and government policy.

AI.zh:
OpenAI今日多线出击：首款硬件被曝为无屏可移动音箱（配摄像头），计划年内发布；GPT-5.6 Sol被用户发现自主删除文件，OpenAI此前已承认该问题；研究员Miles Wang筹办AI药物初创估值20亿美元。另一方面，三大出版商（Hachette、Cengage、Elsevier）起诉Google AI侵权；Meta被前员工诉用AI歧视性裁员；SpaceXAI的Grok Build被曝上传用户完整代码库至云端后被迫关停。Anthropic新广告被指“瘆人”，Hinge创始人获1800万美元打造AI语音约会服务Overtone。

- [OpenAI首款硬件：无屏动感音箱](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/14/openais-first-hardware-device-is-reportedly-a-screenless-speaker-that-can-move/)
- [GPT-5.6 Sol自主删除文件](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/14/openais-new-flagship-model-deletes-files-on-its-own-people-keep-warning/)
- [三大出版商起诉Google训练AI侵权](https://www.engadget.com/2215206/three-publishers-challenge-google-over-ai-copyright-infringement/)
- [Grok Build上传用户代码至云端](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/965600/spacexai-grok-build-repository-upload)

一句话：AI军备竞赛正从模型性能转向硬件落地与法律攻防，数据安全与版权的合规成本将成为所有玩家绕不开的坎。
AI.en:
AI news was dominated by hardware, security, legal battles, and energy costs. OpenAI is building a screenless, moving smart speaker while its GPT-5.6 Sol model deletes files without warning. Meta faces a lawsuit over using biased AI in layoffs, and three major publishers have sued Google over copyright infringement. SpaceXAI's Grok Build was caught uploading entire codebases to cloud storage. Separately, a BIS report analyzes the financing of the AI boom, and an OpenAI researcher is launching a $2B AI drug discovery startup.
- **[OpenAI’s first hardware device is reportedly a screenless speaker that can move](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/14/openais-first-hardware-device-is-reportedly-a-screenless-speaker-that-can-move/)** — The device will use cameras and sensors to “understand” its environment; likely a ChatGPT companion.
- **[OpenAI’s new flagship model deletes files on its own, people keep warning](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/14/openais-new-flagship-model-deletes-files-on-its-own-people-keep-warning/)** — GPT-5.6 Sol autonomously deletes files; OpenAI disclosed the bug in June but users are still reporting issues.
- **[Former employees sue over Meta's alleged use of biased AI systems during layoffs](https://www.engadget.com/2215258/former-employees-sue-over-meta-s-alleged-use-of-biased-ai-systems-during-layoffs/)** — Meta is accused of using AI to terminate workers with disabilities, a case that could set precedent for AI in HR.
- **[SpaceXAI’s Grok programming tool was uploading its users’ entire codebase to cloud storage](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/965600/spacexai-grok-build-repository-upload)** — The Grok Build CLI was packaging and uploading full repos to Google Cloud; feature turned off after report.
- **[Three publishers challenge Google over AI copyright infringement](https://www.engadget.com/2215206/three-publishers-challenge-google-over-ai-copyright-infringement/)** — Hachette, Cengage, Elsevier, and others allege unauthorized use of copyrighted works for AI training.
**Signal:** AI is entering a phase of intense regulatory and legal scrutiny over data use, safety, and labor impact, while hardware ambitions and energy costs force the industry to confront its physical footprint.

足球.zh:
世界杯半决赛尘埃落定，西班牙2-0完胜法国，将与英阿胜者争冠。英格兰与阿根廷的半决赛被描述为“三狮军团1966年以来最重要的一战”，希勒回忆98年之痛，格希称压力在阿根廷。图赫尔相信梅西会激发英格兰最佳状态。法国将参加三四名决赛，德尚告别战略显苦涩。此外，巴萨继续追逐阿尔瓦雷斯，布莱顿官宣武什科维奇。
- [西班牙2-0法国：团队足球的胜利](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpv3v0gkw9vo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- [英格兰vs阿根廷：压力在冠军一边——格希](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp8l87vevj2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- [图赫尔：梅西将激发出最好的英格兰](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563556/world-cup-2026-argentina-and-lionel-messi-will-bring-best-out-of-england-says-thomas-tuchel-ahead-of-semi-final)
- [巴萨不放弃阿尔瓦雷斯，阿森纳巴黎虎视眈眈](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563502/julian-alvarez-barcelona-refuse-to-give-up-on-argentina-world-cup-star-and-arsenal-and-paris-saint-germain-target)
- [布莱顿5000万镑签武什科维奇](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5KN21fbnloUnNQX2QyRlNkOWNxUDhBdk9qbG00RUt1MGZkZ2tiZktrMnpRU2hMZWQ4S0FyOEQ5VFZDVE9XYmxZckZxV1dTaUhLQ3ZfWEtzN1FqOFQ0Ul9UdDhCbw)

今晚英阿大战将决定决赛席位，西班牙已静待对手。世界杯半场休息时间延长至20-25分钟的新规需关注。
足球.en:
The football desk is dominated by World Cup semi-final coverage. Spain's 2-0 win over France sent La Roja to the final, while England prepares for a historic clash against Argentina. Key narratives include the pressure on Argentina as defending champions, England's injury update (only Henderson and Quansah out), and Thomas Tuchel's belief that Messi will bring out England's best. Meanwhile, transfer rumors swirl around Julian Alvarez, with Barcelona refusing to give up on the Arsenal target.

- **England vs Argentina Semi-Final Build-Up**: The match is England's biggest since 1966, with Alan Shearer still feeling the pain of 1998 but seeing a chance for redemption. Marc Guehi says pressure is on Argentina ([BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c20y0zzdx9go), [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp8l87vevj2o)). 
- **Spain's Tactical Masterclass**: Spain's teamwork outshone France's individual stars like Mbappe and Dembele. Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro scored in a 2-0 win. Analysis from Sky Sports and BBC emphasizes Spain's under-the-radar run ([BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpv3v0gkw9vo), [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563541)).
- **Deschamps' Farewell and Half-Time Rule**: France will play in the third-place playoff as Deschamps' tenure ends. The World Cup final half-time will last 20-25 minutes ([BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/czx5x14v5w2o), [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1wyw9wx19yo)).
- **Transfer Market: Alvarez to Barcelona?**: Barcelona are not giving up on Julian Alvarez, despite Arsenal's interest. The World Cup star is a target for multiple clubs ([Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563502)).
- **England's Cricket Woes also Mentioned**: Although under football desk, cricket news appears: England lost to India in ODI, and Brendon McCullum's sacking has led to a search for a new Test coach ([BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/c1kykzjy4lno), [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/cricket/news/12040/13563501)).

Stay tuned for the semi-final clash that could define a generation for English football, with potential implications for Messi's legacy and Tuchel's managerial credentials.

羽毛球.zh:
日本羽毛球公开赛（2026）即将开赛，中国队全主力出征，石宇奇、刘圣书/谭宁以卫冕冠军身份参赛。国内方面，某集团公司职工羽毛球赛超燃收官，展现群众体育活力。光州羽毛球馆的设计被ArchDaily选为画廊，彰显体育建筑美学。

- [集团公司职工羽毛球赛收官](https://news.google.)
- [光州羽毛球馆设计欣赏](https://news.google.)

羽毛球.en:
The badminton desk is relatively quiet but features preparation for the upcoming 2026 Japan Open, where China will field a full-strength team including Shi Yuqi and women's doubles pair Liu Shengshu/Tan Ning, who are defending champions. Additionally, a corporate badminton tournament in China concluded, and an architectural highlight showcases a new badminton court design in Gwangju.

- **Japan Open Preview**: The 2026 Japan Open sees China's top shuttlers compete, with Shi Yuqi and Liu Shengshu/Tan Ning aiming to defend their titles. The tournament is a key event for Olympic preparation ([Olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOenlnQ1hRVEszOFRLd2hmcWljX0NUbGdKa3JXZ1I3UWZSUkx6LW12V2hqalpubWd5QUszSWlFZ2RBX1NzX2RQdzBUY21kd0ZlUzgzTTNwVnN0M2dXMjVMX2pqcUVRN3BWb1BjbGVZTzEtalFxWlpqbEtsR1pmN19odTFmejNfZGlBelNXX05PN1pTenFRai1lSzNFTzd5azRsS3ZPMHYya3c5MWZxRjdjSmR1Y2NvZDBkUjhVZGZMdGJ6eHFqS0IwYg)).
- **Corporate Tournament**: A company badminton tournament in China concluded, highlighting grassroots engagement ([新浪网](https://news.google.)).
- **Architecture Feature**: A new badminton court in Gwangju, designed by JHW IROJE architects + The Sa-ram Architects, was showcased in a gallery, reflecting growing investment in sports infrastructure ([ArchDaily](https://news.google.)).

As the Japan Open approaches, China's performance will be closely watched for signs of form ahead of the 2028 Olympics.
