虎扑社区动态.en:
Hupu community dynamics reflect strong engagement with World Cup content, mixed with gaming and anime polls. The top story is a 'lowest-rated anime female leads' list where Sakura Haruno scored 2.7, but users criticized small sample size. World Cup highlights include Spain's win over France, detailed player touch stats, and a massive total attendance of 6,527,410 across 100 matches. Gaming news covers League of Legends 'double Zed' moment and Honor of Kings hero adjustments. Basketball summer league rookie comparisons also trend.

- **World Cup Attendance Milestone**: 100 matches drawn 6,527,410 spectators, underscoring the tournament's scale ([MSN](https://news.google.)).
- **Anime Poll Controversy**: Hupu users rated anime female leads, with Sakura Haruno at 2.7, but criticism over limited sample suggests the list is for entertainment only ([网易](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1Ea1NHUmRfVjZ2bEE3LTRzS2hoeG85b3J6VVZoOElfNXBxOVE4STBmUExVR2xfSGw1SFJIRktOSTgtcEZtTUJRWkVDVzk3VW9UNlo3RHlVZDRQRXI0LVdGZHlR)).
- **Spain vs France Tactical Insights**: Yamal, Oyarzabal, and Mbappe led in penalty area touches; analysis of semi-final dynamics ([Sina Sports](https://news.google.)).
- **Gaming and Esports**: LOL Esports shared the iconic 'double Zed' moment from Faker vs Ryu, and Honor of Kings test server updated heroes Yin, Baili Shouyue, and Shen Mengxi ([MSN](https://news.google.)).
- **Summer League Rookie Watch**: American media compared Cooper Flagg and Dylan Harper's first two summer league games; top 4 picks' scoring: Harper 25, Peterson 25, Boozer 19, Wilson 27 ([腾讯新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBYcjU3T1VlSzVPb1laSGJQcDlfLWlSSGY4RFhqcHdRQnF0azNOUzdrSU5UTl83T2ZBV2RkSlV1YTdWWXZDSnBHV2prQ1Vfd0lFZms5QTBB)).

The Hupu community remains a vibrant hub for fans to debate sports, esports, and pop culture, with World Cup content driving the highest engagement.

篮球.zh:
今日篮球圈聚焦两则话题：一是媒体人炮轰CBA“出口转内销”现象，称除NBA外，其他出国打球都是为了回来拿高薪；二是杨瀚森青训成长历程被重提。此外，曾在单场砍下53分的球员（疑似肯巴·沃克或某砍分高手）正式告别NBA加盟欧洲联赛，引发唏嘘。前阿根廷国手斯科拉46岁成为球队老板，四子打造篮球世家，与姚明对比引发讨论。
- [媒体人：CBA球员出口转内销真相](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1kS1RMdE96bjRzYTBEaUZRTUZYRTJ3a2pOdlpMdjN6SDNXd05sRGRvQ3VZZlJ1NkRhdlhhWHl2VEVNMzZTWlV6RVRiSTJiendINWd4Z0dVUVVjbzdiUjJpRzJWZk82bjVlMVNiendpNDA)
- [杨瀚森青训成长历程](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE1DQVZKY0p4dDVZRnFELXJjcHRsZEQ2aUxlV1hvN2drRHY4bXBrSmk2YWJZOU10MmVFQnNldURKOGc2UERad0syYmZhS0hPd2pBWWNLSHdYUTJOeGV5R3hoNktWN2tHVThyYlQ3dDZJc3dzWE5Ka3RN)
- [53分杀神正式告别NBA转战欧洲](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1DMGhuRlNGWXRyRFZYX0pCWUVnREpvbWFUY09iUW1FSk9LcEZBTkN0cGk2ODNVS0xxNzFIQkpOWlc4c200X3A0NlkwZGZwNF9WZ2ZtLW44aDgxYzFzcldKSWdn)
- [46岁斯科拉成球队老板，四子打造篮球世家](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNYVVkaFhub1o5dG83clN6SEgxamtFMEJSbk1nOTRQVXVMVEM2QnVuMFh4Um9iQldnTGhid3A2UFFfcjB3VlZJcWN4OGNrR3puNzlBM3Y5M2hwa3NYNk9tbjdjQnQxRnFYbGctZnN1M3pQSHJYUGhPTjRFSGV5TUx2QjdJbVdUdFE1ZlFJRA)

CBA休赛期负面舆情不断，出口转内销争议折射青训与留洋困境。斯科拉的商业成功与家庭规划则为中国篮球人提供另一种范本。
篮球.en:
The basketball desk features a mix of CBA commentary, NBA player moves, and nostalgic profiles. Media criticism of CBA players 'exporting to import' for higher salaries continues, with a focus on Yang Hansen's development in the youth system. A 53-point scorer (likely a former NBA player) is leaving the NBA for Europe, while Luis Scola's post-retirement life as a team owner and father of a basketball family draws comparisons to Yao Ming.

- **CBA Player Export Debate**: A media personality claims that CBA players who go abroad (except those going to the NBA) do so only to return for higher salaries, labeling it 'export-to-import'. This fuels ongoing discussion about Chinese basketball development ([中华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1kS1RMdE96bjRzYTBEaUZRTUZYRTJ3a2pOdlpMdjN6SDNXd05sRGRvQ3VZZlJ1NkRhdlhhWHl2VEVNMzZTWlV6RVRiSTJiendINWd4Z0dVUVVjbzdiUjJpRzJWZk82bjVlMVNiendpNDA)).
- **Yang Hansen's Youth Journey**: A detailed look at how Yang Hansen grew through the CBA youth system, relevant for Chinese basketball prospects ([新浪体育](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE1DQVZKY0p4dDVZRnFELXJjcHRsZEQ2aUxlV1hvN2drRHY4bXBrSmk2YWJZOU10MmVFQnNldURKOGc2UERad0syYmZhS0hPd2pBWWNLSHdYUTJOeGV5R3hoNktWN2tHVThyYlQ3dDZJc3dzWE5Ka3RN)).
- **NBA Departure: 53-Point Scorer to Europe**: A player who once scored 53 points in an NBA game is leaving for a European league, signaling a shift in talent distribution ([网易](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1DMGhuRlNGWXRyRFZYX0pCWUVnREpvbWFUY09iUW1FSk9LcEZBTkN0cGk2ODNVS0xxNzFIQkpOWlc4c200X3A0NlkwZGZwNF9WZ2ZtLW44aDgxYzFzcldKSWdn)).
- **Luis Scola's Post-Retirement Success**: At 46, former NBA and international star Luis Scola has become a team owner, with four sons building a basketball dynasty. Articles question whether Yao Ming envies this path ([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNYVVkaFhub1o5dG83clN6SEgxamtFMEJSbk1nOTRQVXVMVEM2QnVuMFh4Um9iQldnTGhid3A2UFFfcjB3VlZJcWN4OGNrR3puNzlBM3Y5M2hwa3NYNk9tbjdjQnQxRnFYbGctZnN1M3pQSHJYUGhPTjRFSGV5TUx2QjdJbVdUdFE1ZlFJRA)).

With the NBA offseason progressing and CBA player movements, the basketball desk highlights the evolving landscape of international basketball careers and Chinese basketball's structural issues.

欧美.zh: 好莱坞正在经历从内容到资本的全面震荡。派拉蒙Primal厂牌以竞标方式拿下R级喜剧[《Boys For Life》](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tyler-falbo-boys-for-life-teyana-taylor-get-lite-release-date-1236982363/)，片场已开拍，日期定在2027年4月9日——这显示出新厂牌对成人喜剧市场的野心。与此同时，12州总检察长[起诉阻挡派拉蒙与华纳兄弟探索合并](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/paramount-warner-bros-merger-state-ags-daily-variety-1236810547/)，核心争议在于大片能否被视为独立市场，这一法律界定将影响整个行业。另外，安雅·泰勒-乔伊主演的Apple TV+限定剧[《Lucky》](https://variety.com/2026/tv/reviews/lucky-review-apple-tv-anya-taylor-joy-1236806733/)今日开播，讲述一名骗子女郎的逃亡故事，媒体口碑两极化但演技获赞。总体来看，短期内法律变数高于内容热度。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk is dominated by a high-stakes antitrust lawsuit against the Paramount-Warner Bros. merger and several notable film and TV developments. A coalition of 12 Democratic state AGs, led by California, has sued to block the $111 billion merger, arguing it would give the combined entity outsized power in theatrical distribution, tentpole movies, and basic cable. Paramount has called the suit a distortion of settled law, and the case is expected to turn on whether 'blockbuster films' constitute a distinct market. Separately, Paramount's new label Primal has acquired the R-rated comedy 'Boys For Life' (April 2027 release), while Teyana Taylor's 'Get Lite' was pushed to late summer 2027.

- **Antitrust Suit**: The lawsuit by 12 states challenges the Paramount-Warner Bros. merger, focusing on market concentration in theatrical and cable. [Variety analysis](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/paramount-warner-bros-rob-bonta-state-ags-sue-blockbusters-1236810931/)
- **Paramount Primal’s First Acquisition**: 'Boys For Life', directed by Tyler Falbo, gets a spring 2027 release. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tyler-falbo-boys-for-life-teyana-taylor-get-lite-release-date-1236982363/)
- **Alix Earle vs. Alex Cooper**: Earle says she will eventually address the feud, calling it a 'serious struggle behind the scenes'. [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/alix-earle-reveals-when-address-alex-cooper-feud-netflix-1236648913/)
- **Andy Serkis Directs 'Hunt for Gollum' in Character**: Warner Bros. released set footage showing Serkis in motion-capture. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/andy-serkis-hunt-for-gollum-set-footage-1236982655/)
- **Christopher Nolan’s 'Odyssey'**: Nolan crammed inside a Trojan Horse with 20 actors for a pivotal scene; the film premiered in NYC. [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/christopher-nolan-inside-trojan-horse-the-odyssey-premiere-1236648771/)

This morning’s signals point to a volatile legal battle ahead for Hollywood’s biggest merger, while individual projects continue to move forward despite uncertainty.

日韩.zh: 韩娱今日稳定信号明显。NCT 127七人[全员续约SM](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854749wpp/nct-127-renews-contracts-with-sm-entertainment)，结束续约传闻，SM股价或受提振。音乐榜单方面，Jennie与Tame Impala的《Dracula》remix打入Billboard Hot 100第5名，[成为第二位进入Top 5的K-pop女歌手](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854718wpp/blackpinks-jennie-becomes-2nd-female-k-pop-artist-to-enter-top-5-of-billboard-hot-100)，争议后商业价值不减。综艺方面，Disney+推出AI推理节目[《Murder Club》](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854797wpp/watch-tvxqs-changmin-txts-beomgyu-and-more-join-murder-club-in-new-ai-based-deduction-game-show-teasers)，TVXQ昌珉和TXT崔范奎加盟，AI元素为推理题材增添新意。此外，Circle Chart公布上半年数据，BTS专辑榜居首；第41届金唱片奖将于2027年1月在河内举办，首次落地越南。整体来看，头部续约稳定军心，新生代综艺探索科技融合。
日韩.en:
The Japanese and Korean entertainment desk is buzzing with significant K-pop contract renewals, chart achievements, and upcoming award show news. NCT 127 has renewed all members’ contracts with SM Entertainment, ensuring the group’s continued activities. BLACKPINK’s Jennie made history by reaching No. 5 on the Billboard Hot 100 with her 'Dracula' remix, becoming only the second female K-pop artist to enter the top 5. Meanwhile, the 41st Golden Disc Awards will be held in Hanoi, Vietnam, in January 2027—a first for the ceremony. On the drama front, tvN's 'Spooky in Love' (a remake of 'Spellbound') released a new preview, and Disney+ announced the AI deduction show 'Murder Club' featuring TVXQ's Changmin and TXT's Beomgyu.

- **NCT 127 Renews with SM**: All seven members signed new exclusive contracts. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854749wpp/nct-127-renews-contracts-with-sm-entertainment)
- **Jennie's Billboard Milestone**: Her collaboration with Tame Impala hits No. 5 on Hot 100. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854718wpp/blackpinks-jennie-becomes-2nd-female-k-pop-artist-to-enter-top-5-of-billboard-hot-100)
- **Golden Disc Awards in Hanoi**: The ceremony moves to Vietnam for the first time. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854772wpp/41st-golden-disc-awards-unveils-location-and-details)
- **ENHYPEN’s Sunoo Withdraws from Mexico Concert**: Due to sudden health decline. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854761wpp/enhypens-sunoo-to-sit-out-of-mexico-concert-due-to-health)
- **New AI Deduction Show 'Murder Club'**: Disney+ program with celebrity participants. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854797wpp/watch-tvxqs-changmin-txts-beomgyu-and-more-join-murder-club-in-new-ai-based-deduction-game-show-teasers)

With NCT 127 secured and Jennie breaking US records, the Korean industry remains robust, though health issues for Sunoo remind us of the intense touring demands.

中国.zh: 中国影视市场呈现两极分化。《功夫女足》票房突破7亿元，但[儒意股价“冰火两重天”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBkbTlVaWpSZnNja29lYWtOS29NUnd5a3JIRWk0SFdZdUV2emVrVjM5QkJVSXNkb2tLRzdURzF1NEwzZzVZa0E1bkVvcWxIRFpNcUpHY2lFNGhZaEhVcUU5N2pn)暴露了资本市场的割裂——票房利好但资本方内部博弈复杂。演员方面，白宇荣获“杰出亚洲明星奖”，[肖战在韩国再破天花板](https://news.google.)引发热议，张婧仪则谈及中国剧集出海热潮。技术合作方面，咖魔科技与华策影视达成战略合作，聚焦科技赋能历史叙事。总体而言，头部艺人海外影响力增强，电影票房成功但资本层面仍需观察。
中国.en:
China's entertainment scene this cycle highlights box office successes, international recognition for actors, and strategic tech-culture partnerships. The film 'Kung Fu Women's Football', produced by China Ruyi, has surpassed 700M yuan in box office, though its parent company's stock performance has been volatile, indicating investor caution. Actor Bai Yu won the Outstanding Asian Star award, while Xiao Zhan continues to gain traction in South Korea, breaking perceived ceilings for Chinese artists. Industry partnerships are also notable: Cama Tech and Huace Film & TV signed a deep strategic cooperation to use technology for historical narratives, and 18 Hong Kong game companies will appear at the upcoming China International Digital Interactive Entertainment Exhibition (Chinajoy).

- **'Kung Fu Women's Football' Box Office**: Grossed over 700M yuan, but stock of producer China Ruyi shows mixed reaction. [NetEase](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBkbTlVaWpSZnNja29lYWtOS29NUnd5a3JIRWk0SFdZdUV2emVrVjM5QkJVSXNkb2tLRzdURzF1NEwzZzVZa0E1bkVvcWxIRFpNcUpHY2lFNGhZaEhVcUU5N2pn)
- **Bai Yu Wins Outstanding Asian Star**: Recognition at an international ceremony. [Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxQRjVZQkg4b3N0eVhQZlcwTHVFa0hBS3ZnYS1GOFg3Ni0wbGQwR0g5dmw0NzFna0lXV2ZwdnRBTE15SEg4eEVxZV9ONmtfeE5JR0w3WkMyWXlDQkVsUUkyVko3c1FFal9rVnJYQjY2clpZelhYLUk1RGdFWVg0eUJpZQ)
- **Xiao Zhan's Korean Appeal**: The actor is gaining significant attention in South Korea. [Sina](https://news.google.)
- **Tech-Entertainment Partnership**: Cama Tech and Huace Film & TV collaborate on history-focused content. [cb.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1nY29Gd3hGTUJ4aC1lNG5URDd2TG1Zb2RTaklVa085T1ZLR3FmSDFDWWNYMlZoUjdnMHZjZjViQzliV0NKLUY4RkRfZmJPeWVGcTdtVXJSV2lERW5tTkVEOUhRYw)
- **Hong Kong Game Companies at Chinajoy**: 18 firms to attend the 23rd Digital Interactive Entertainment Exhibition. [NetEase](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9Rdkh6T3k2V2U3c0poREloVEFMRFBhcXNCNTNUc0JZYXJJT0p6NmZ3VlU2aXlKZ0pNWmdoeV90Xy1pZG02czhDOU9qQXplaTNIVjQ5SjVEZXY3UWZHOHUyczJR)

The domestic box office is recovering strongly, but equity markets show that success on screen does not always translate to investor confidence. Cross-border appeal of Chinese stars is an emerging trend to watch.
